tei:div.tei:p: rtsom sgrig u yon lhan khang /kru'u rin/ dgra 'dul/kru'u rin gzhon pa/ gdugs dkar tshe ring /gtso sgrig pa/ bsod nams tshe ring /gco sgrig gzhon pa/ rta mgrin skyabs/ rin chen don grub/sgrol ma rgya mtsho/rtsom sgrig u yon/ rdo rje tshe ring / tshe ring thar/ gsang bdagapadma rdo rje/ blo gros/ bde skyid sgrol ma/bkra rgyal/ zla ba tshe ring / dbang phyug mtsho mo/lis zha'o kru'u/ lha byams rgyal/

0 0 phroṃrtsa ṣṭha sgoṣṭharjo//rtsaṣṭha myo7lorākrertsa tshi rsākhyeṣkarātram̐khyu//rtsatshi ༅kṣume0sku༈rjo.oṃz-itshochisgolholkoṣātshi za za.oṃlkokhrikhyaciloṭwāṃtram̐.oṃ༄ṭwā⑫rizalhozarkeri 7rmyaṣāsku⑫ oṃsgolhoskultakhyime0༄ skrekhritsholkosnyetram̐༄sturwalkoṣā7skustsalho po༄7rkime0

sngon 'gro'i gtam/legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs la 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i gtam/gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing ri klung bar khams thams cad rnam par dag pa'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir/bod mi rigs rnams lo ngo stong phrag du ma'i snga rol nas gzhis chags shing 'tsho gzhes gnang ste 'od stong rnam par bkra ba'i lo rgyus bskrun yod la/ khyad par du bod rig pa zhes mtshan snyan 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon la mngon par ldir ba'i rig gnas kyi bang mdzod zad mtha' med pa zhig nga tsho phyi rabs pa'i bgo skal du stsal cing / gnam gyis sa bkab pa lta bu'i mkhas dbang mang po rim par byon nas dus rabs so sor rnam pa mi 'dra ba'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos sna tshogs shig rtsom gnang mdzad pa dang /bod rang gi khyad chos dang yongs su mthun pa'i legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa gsar ba zhig gsar skrun bgyis pa des/1

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsom rig spyi'i rigs sam lus kyi rnam pa je mang je tshang du btang ba yin pas/ rtsom rig gi gzhung lugs thad bla na med pa'i mdzad rjes shig dang rmad du byung ba'i dge mtshan zhig bskrun par snang ngo / /skabs bab kyi brjod bya legs bshad ces pa'i tha snyad de don gang la 'jug ce na/ yongs grags su sgra yangs 'jug dang dog 'jug gnyis su dbye ste brjod par bya dgos te/ tshig sbyor snyan zhing don gyis phyug pa'i gsung rnam dag dang bstan bcos mtha' dag la legs bshad ces pa sgra yangs 'jug gi don yin la/ rtsom stangs nges can zhig gis 'ching ba'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la legs bshad ces pa sgra dog 'jug gi don yin no/ /de ltar 'jug pa'i don gnyis ni phan tshun 'gal bar mi 'gyur te/ de gnyis bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel ba yod pa'i phyir/ sgra dog 'jug gi don ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin na yangs 'jug gi don gyi rang bzhin ldan pas khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /yin na'ang sgra yangs 'jug gi don ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin na dog 'jug gi don gyi bdag 2

sngon 'gro'i gtam/nyid ldan pa'i brtsams chos yin pa'i nges pa ma mchis so/ /'dir brjod pa'i legs bshad ni sgra dog 'jug gi don yin te/ rtsom rig gi rnam pa zhig la brjod pa yin no/ /'di lta bu'i legs bshad ces pa'i rtsom rig gi rnam pa der khyad chos ci zhig ldan zhe na/ de la 'di ltar brtag dgos te/brjod bya sna mang phun tshogs la dpe don legs par sbyar te tshigs bcad kyi rnam pas ston pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos la legs bshad ces pa'i tha snyad btags pa yin/ de'i brjod bya sna mang phun tshogs yin par smra bar rgyu mtshan yod de/ rtsom pa pos bod kyi spyi tshogs kyi gnas bab dang bstun nas chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ chos lugs/ slob gso/ dmag don la sogs pa chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya dngos mang po la legs par dpyad nas/chos lugs kyi bsam blo/ srid 'dzin gyi thabs lam/ mkhas blun gyi spyod pa/ blang dor gyi tshad gzhi bcas lkog gyur gyi don mang po la rang nyid kyi lta stangs dang bzhed tshul gsal bar ston pa'i brtsams chos yin pa'i phyir ro/ /legs bshad bstan bcos de sgyu 3

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtsal gyi rang bzhin yongs su gtams pa'i rtsom rig gi brtsams chos yin pa'i dbang gis/ de'i rjod byed kyi tshig dang ston byed kyi thabs la brtsams chos gzhan dang mi mthun pa'i khyad chos mang po yod/ mdor sdud na/ legs bshad kyi brtsams chos mtha' dag tshigs bcad kyi rnam pa yin pa dang gcig sho lo ka gcig las tshig rkang gnyis dpe dang tshig rkang gnyis don snga phyi nges med du legs par sbyar te bstan bya rdzogs par ston pa dang gnyis/gsal byed kyi dpe skye bo mkhas blun thams cad kyis nyams su myong ba'am thos pa las byung ba'i yun ring du 'dris pa'i bya dngos yin pa dang gsum/ tshig sbyor bde zhing go sla ba/ dmangs khrod kyi gtam dpe'i rang bzhin ldan pa/ skye bo kun gyis dka' tshegs med par bde blag tu 'jug nus pa dang bzhi/ tshig snyan zhing ro nyams ldan pa/ skye bo mchog dman kun gyi mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa dang lnga'i khyad par gyi yon tan ldan pa yin no/ /de lta bu'i yon tan lnga ldan gyi rtsom rig gi rnam pa de/ bod mi rigs kyi rtsom rig lo rgyus thog gal che zhing 'phang mtho ba'i go sa yod par mkhas pa 4

sngon 'gro'i gtam/rnams kyis yang yang du bsngags pa'o/ /legs bshad rtsom rig de bod la ji ltar byung ba dang ji ltar 'phel ba'i lo rgyus thad cung tsam dpyad na/ bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/ ma ṇi bka' 'bum dang tun hong yig cha nas zhal gdams zhes pa dpe don sbyar nas bslab bya'i rang bzhin yod pa'i brtsams chos byung / de dag ni legs bshad rtsom rig gi sa bon lta bur gyur te/ rtsom rig gi rnam pa de bod yul du thog mar gzhi chags so/ /de rjes spyi lo dus rabs bcu gsum par sa skya pashlau ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis zhal gdams de dag gi srol rgyun gzhir byas shing / 'phags yul gyi rtsom rig skye bo gso thigs sogs brtsams chos 'ga' dper byas nas legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i sho lo ka bzhi brgya lhag yod pa'i brtsams chos mdzad de/ legs bshad rtsom rig gi rnam gzhag gtan la phab/ dus rabs bcu drug par paṇa chen bsod nams grags pas sa skya legs bshad kyi rnam gzhag dang cha yongs su mtshungs pa'i mkhas blun brtag pa'i bstan bcos dge ldan legs 5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bshad padma dkar po'i chun po zhes bya ba sho lo ka brgya lhag ldan pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ legs bshad rtsom rig gi rnam pa de je rgyas je legs su btang / de rjes dus rabs bco brgyad par gung thang bstan pa'i sgron mes gong smras legs bshad bstan bcos dag ma dper byas nas chu'i bstan bcos dang shing gi bstan bcos zhes bsdoms pas sho lo ka nyis brgya lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos gnyis mdzad pa dang / dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i mkhas dbang dkyil zur blo bzang sbyin pas gung thang pa'i chu shing bstan bcos kyi rtsom stangs dang yongs su mthun pa'i lugs zung ba dan g.yo ba'i legs bshad rlung gi bstan bcos zhes bya ba sho lo ka drug cu lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos dang / 'jig rten mi chos dang 'brel ba'i bslab bya gsal bar ston pa'i legs bshad zla ba'i bstan bcos zhes pa sho lo ka sum cu lhag yod pa'i bstan bcos sogs du ma mdzad/ brtsams chos de dag ni thog mtha' bar gsum du dpe chos can gcig gi steng du de'i skyon yon brtags shing don dang sbyar nas bslab bya'i tshul gyis ston pa yin 6

sngon 'gro'i gtam/pas legs bshad kyi rtsom stangs gsar ba zhig spel ba yin/gzhan yang mkhas dbang 'ju mi pham 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal rgya mtshos gong smras legs bshad rtsom stangs kyi legs cha yongs su bsdus nas rgyal po lugs kyi bstan bcos zhes bya ba le'u nyer gcig dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos mdzad de/ legs bshad kyi rtsom stangs gong nas gong du spel ba yin no/ /smras pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi pir rtse las/ /thon pa'i leṭa par bshad pa'i bstan bcos rnams/ /rang re gangs can rtsom rig bang mdzod du/ /'od 'bar nor bu gcig tu ci yang snang / /de yang 'dzam gling rig gnas dga' tshal du/ /legs bshad ces pa'i me tog mtshar sdug cig /rnam par bzhad pas phyi nang mkhas pa yi/ /yid kyi bung ba dbang med phyogs 'dir 'khor/ /'di ltar legs bshad kyi che ba brjod pa dang rtsom rig gi rin thang dpog pa ni/ rtog bzo dang sgro 'dogs kyi gtam tsam ma 7

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yin te/ bstan bcos de dag gi dngos gzhi dang de las byung ba'i phan yon gyis bsgrubs pas so/ /'o na legs bshad bstan bcos las byung ba'i phan yon ci yod ce na/ gzhan phan dge phyogs la mos pa dang sdig pa mi dge ba spong dgos pa'i slob gso gtong ba dang gcig yon tan la bstod cing blun rmongs la smad pa'i bsam blo spel ba dang gnyis/ las la brtson pa dang le lo spong dgos pa'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang gsum/ che ba la gus shing chung ba la gces pa'i lugs bzang spel ba dang bzhi/ mthun sgril la dga' zhing dbyen 'byed la sdang ba'i spyod bzang dar spel gtong ba dang lnga'o/ /'di lta bu'i phyogs lnga las bslab bya'i tshul gyis gdams te/ mi rnams kyi bsam blo dag sbyong dang kun spyod legs skyong byed pa la phan yon dpag dka' ba byung zhing / bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas dpal yon dang bsam blo'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun byed pa dang spyi tshogs mthun sgrig byed pa la phan nus gzhal dka' ba bton pa yin no/ /da res mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis legs bshad 8

sngon 'gro'i gtam/bstan bcos de dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus nas legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs zhes pa'i dpe tshogs par skrun byas pa de/ spyi tshogs la phan pa'i dge mtshan dang / rig gnas la phan pa'i don snying ldan pa zhig yin no/ /gna' mo'i legs bshad bstan bcos kyis/ /spel ba'i dgongs pa'i dge mchan de/ /deng gi bsam blo'i dpal yon gyi/ /don snying dang mthun e ma rmad/ /ces spyi lo2006lo'i zla3pa'i tshes24nyin gyi na ba blo bzang chos grags kyis bris pa'o/ /bkra shis/ dge'o/ /

dkar chagarngadab/ra 35bkalegs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ (1)rab tu byed pa dang po/ mkhas pa brtag pa/ (2)rab tu byed pa gnyis pa/ ya rabs brtag pa/ (10)rab tu byed pa gsum pa/ blun po brtag pa/ (18)rab tu byed pa bzhi ba/ spel ma brtag pa/ (30)rab tu byed pa lnga ba/ ngan spyod brtag pa/ (42)rab tu byed pa drug pa/ rang bzhin gyi tshul brtag pa/ (55)rab tu byed pa bdun pa/ mi rigs pa'i tshul dpyad pa/ (73)rab tu byed pa brgyad pa/ bya ba brtag pa/ (86)rab tu byed pa dgu ba/ chos brtag pa/ (112)legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter gyi rnam par bshad pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / (131)

da dge———— saskyalegasabashad kyi rtsa ba/༄/ /rgya gar skad du/ subhā ṣi ta ratna ni rnyi nā ma shāst+ra/bod skad du/ legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha yi mchog dang klu dbang grub pa rig 'dzin gtso/ /drang srong rgyas pa grog mkhar ba dang rkang mig sogs/ /kun nas dga' ba'i gtsug gi nor bus zhabs mchod pa/ /'gro ba'i gtso bo kun marṣa de la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /rigs pas dpyad na chos lugs mi 'gal zhing / /'jig rten bya ba kun nas legs bsgrub pa/ /dam pa rnams kyi spyod tshul ci 'dra zhig /bshad pa 'di ni legs bshad rin chen gter/ /

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa rab tuzud pa dang dzo/ mkhas pa brtag pa/mkhas pa yon tan mdzod 'dzin pa/ /de dag legs bshad rin chen sdud/ /rgya mtsho chen po chu bo'i gter/ /yin phyir chu bo thams cad 'bab/ /skye bo yon tan yod med pa'i/ /blang dor blo gros ldan pa mkhas/ /rdul dang 'dres pa'i lcags phye rnams/ /khab len rdo yis len par shes/ /legs bshad mkhas pa'i blo gros kyis/ /go yi blun pos de lta min/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba na/ /'byung bo'i bya rnams long bar 'gyur/ /2

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/shes rab ldan pas nyes pa dag /sel bar nus kyi blun pos min/ /nam mkha' lding gis dug can sbrul/ /gsod par nus kyi khwa tas min/ /blo gros chen po rgud na yang / / lhag par blo gros stobs ldan 'gyur/ /ri dwags rgyal bo bkres pa na/ /glang chen spyi bo myur du 'gems/ /mkhas pa brtsad cing ma dris pa/ /de yi bar du gting mi dpogs/ /rnga la dbyu gus ma bsnun par/ /de srid gzhan dang khyad ci yod/ /rig pa nangs par 'chi yang bslab/ /tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / /skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/ /3

da legasabashad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa genor la rang nyid len pa 'dra/ /yon tan ldan na skye bo kun/ /ma bsdus par yang rang nyid 'du/ /dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / /bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor/ /mkhas pa yon tan kun bslabs pa/ /mthar phyin gcig gis 'jig rten gsal/ /blo ngan shes pa mang na yang / /rgyu skar bzhin du gsal mi nus/ /mkhas pa yon tan dpag med kyang / /gzhan gyi yon tan chung ngu'ang len/ /de ltar rgyun du spyad pa yis/ /myur du thams cad mkhyen par 'gro/ /mkhas pa shes rab kyis bsrungs na/ /4

— saskyalegasabashad kyi rtsa ba/dgra bo mang yang ga la tshugs/ /'phags rgyal gyi ni bram ze'i bu/ /gcig pus dgra bo'i tshogs kun bcom/ /blo chung gros nyes 'khrugs pa'i tshe /blo ldan thabs kyis bde bar gso/ /chu klung rnyog pas chud gsan pa/ /chu dwangs nor bus dwangs par byed/ /mkhas pa ji ltar thabs rdugs kyang / /blun po 'jug pa'i/ lam mi 'gro/ /char sdod byi'u bskom na yang / /sa la 'bab pa'i chu mi 'thung / /shes rab ldan pa mgo bskor yang / /bya ba'i cha la rmongs mi 'gyur/ /srog chags grog ma mig med kyang / /mig ldan gzhan las lhag par mgyogs/ /5

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blo gros ldan pa gnyis bgros na/ / blo gros legs pa gzhan 'byung srid/ /yung ba dang ni tsha la las/ /kha dog gzhan zhig skye bar 'gyur/ /khong mdzangs bsod nams bsags pa'i mi/ /gcig pu yin yang kun las rgyal/ /ri dwags rgyal bo seng ge dang / /'khor los sgyur la grogs mi dgos/ /thabs la mkhas na chen po yang /bran du bkol bar ga la dka'/ /mkha' lding mthu rtsal che na yang / /gos ser can gyi bzhon par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol gyi/ /bde ba bsgrub pa shes rab yin/ /rgyal bu zla ba'i shes rab kyis/ /6

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/bran bzang 'di dang phyi mar bskyabs/ /dpa' zhing mthu rtsal che na yang / /mkhas pa min pas dpal mi thob/ /'byor ba thob par gyur na yang / /bsod nams med na ga la rtag /yon tan skyon gnyis sus kyang gsal/ /'dres pa 'byed shes mkhas pa yin/ /chu las 'o ma ngang bas phyed/ /ba las 'o ma kun gyis longs/ /smras shing bskul bar gyur pa na/ /dud 'gro la yang go ba skye/ /ma bskul gzhan gyis ma smras kyang / /bsam pa shes na mkhas pa yin/ /blo dang ldan na ma smras par/ /7

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rnam 'gyur nyid las bsam pa go /bal bo'i se'u ma zos kyang / /kha dog nyid las bro ba shes/ /mkhas pa rang gi yul bas kyang / /yul khams gzhan na mchod pa thob/ /nor bu gzhan du brin pa tsam/ /rgya mtsho'i gling du ga la brin/ /mkhas pa slob pa'i dus na sdug /bde bar sdod la mkhas mi srid/ /bde ba chung la chags pa des/ /chen po'i bde ba thob mi srid/ /blo dang ldan na nyam chung yang / /stobs ldan dgra bos ci byar yod/ /ri dwags rgyal bo stobs ldan yang / /ri bong blo dang ldan pas bsad/ /8

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/sems can gzhan dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /spyod pa shes na mkhas pa yin/ /dud 'gro yin yang rigs mthun rnams/ /khyu gcig tu ni mi gnas sam/ /nges par 'byung ba'i bya ba 'ga'/ /ma grub pa na dpyod pa'i tshe/ /mkhas rmongs gnyis kyi khyad par shes/ /grub nas dpyod pa blun po'i tshul/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis dpyad pa yi/ /shes bya shes na mkhas par bgrang / /ba lang rgan gzhon dpyod pa la/ /blun po mkhas kyang yon tan min/ /rgya mtsho chu yis mi ngoms shing / /rgyal bo'i bang mdzod nor gyis min/ /'dod yon spyad pas mi ngoms te/ /9

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mkhas pa legs bshad kyis mi ngoms/ /legs bshad byis pa dag las kyang / /mkhas pa rnams ni yongs su len/ /dri zhim byung na ri dwags kyi/ /lte ba las kyang gla rtsi len/ /rab ṭuzud pa gnyis pa/ ya rabs brtag dzee/rtag tu dam pa'i yon tan rnams/ /skye bo dam pas lhag par sgrogs/ /ma la ya yi tsan dan dri/ /rlung gis phyogs bcur rgyas par byed/ /dam pa dpon du bskos gyur na/ /don grub pa dang bde skyid 'thob/ /nor bu rgyal mtshan rtser mchod na/ /yul phyogs dge zhes mkhas rnams sgrogs/ /10

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rgyal dzan gzhan gyis gtses pa na/ /lhag par chos rgyal dran par 'gyur/ /rims kyis btab pa'i sems can rnams/ /gangs chu 'ba' zhig yid la byed/ /sdig spyod rgyal bos gtses pa na/ /mi dbang chos rgyal lhag par skyong / /'byung bo'i gdon gyis btab pa la/ /gsang sngags grub pas rjes su 'dzin/ /dam pa sdug pa chung yang spong / /dman rnams chen po'ang de lta min/ /zho la rdul phran 'byar ba sel/ /chang la phabs kyang lhag par 'debs/ /skye bo dam pa rgud gyur kyang / /spyod pa'i khyad par lhag par mdzes /me ni thur du kha bstan kyang / / 11

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/me lce gyen la 'bar bar mthong / /dam pa rgyang na gnas na yang / /'khor 'dab phan pas ring nas skyong / /mkha' la sprin chen 'khrigs pa yis/ /sa yi lo tog khyad par 'phel/ /gson tshe snyan grags dga' ba'i rgyu/ /'jig rten gzhan du bsod nams dga'/ /de gnyis med pa'i nor tsam gyis/ /mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed mi nus/ /phyi rjes ring du blta ba dang / /bag yod pa la bzod bsran che/ /brtson 'grus che zhing brtan la grims/ /bran g.yog yin yang dpon du 'gyur/ /sbyin la rtag tu sems spro ba/ /12

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/de yi grags pa rlung bzhin ldang / / phongs pa slong ba 'du ba bzhin/ /'bul bar 'dod rnams de bas mang byin nas slar yang mi len la/ /dman pa'i brnyas pa dang du len/ /phan pa chung ngu'ang mi brjed pa/ /bdag nyid chen po'i che rtags yin/ /dam pa'i yon tan sbas gyur kyang / /'jig rten kun la khyad par gsal/ /sna ma'i me tog legs bkab kyang / /dri zhim kun tu khyab par 'gyur/ /rgyal bo rang yul che ba tsam/ /dam pa gang du phyin par bkur/ /me tog phal cher nyin re'i rgyan/ /gtsug gi nor bu gang du'ang mchod/ /13

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ljon shing dud pa 'bras bu mang / /rma bya dul ba mjug sgro bzang / /rta mchog dul ba 'gros mgyogs te/ /dam pa dul ba mkhas pa'i rtags/ /dam pa rnams dang phal ba la/ /byas pa mnyam yang drin mi 'dra/ /zhing la sa bon khyad med kyang / /lo tog khyad par dpag tu med/ /bdag nyid che la phan btags na/ /cung zad tsam yang 'bras bu 'byin/ /skyu ru ra gcig byin pa la/ /chos rgyal bu dang snyoms la ltos/ /bzang bo'i cho rigs spyod pas bsrung / /spyod pa nyams na rigs don med/ /tsan dan dri bzang skye bo dga'/ /14

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/de bsregs sol ba su zhig len/ /chen po re zhig rgud gyur kyang / /de la gdung ba bskyed mi dgos/ /zla ba re zhig gzas zin yang / /de ma thag tu grol bar 'gyur/ /chen pos dgra la byams byas na/ /dgra nyid de yi dbang du 'gyur/ /mang bos bkur bas kun bskyangs pas/ /kun gyis rgyal bor dbang bskur ro/ /dam pa ji ltar rgud gyur kyang / /sdig dang 'dres pa'i zas mi za/ /seng ge bkres kyang mi gtsang ba'i/ /ngan skyugs za bar mi byed do/ /dam pa srog la babs na yang / /15

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang bzhin bzang bo ga la 'dor/ / sa le sbram ni bsregs bcad kyang / /de yi kha dog nyams mi 'gyur/ /skyes mchog rnams la dman pa rnams/ /khro yang lan du ga la khro/ /ce spyang dregs pa'i skad 'byin yang / /ri dwags rgyal bos snying rjes skyong / /bdag nyid che la skye bo rnams/ /skyon tshol 'gyur gyi dman la min/ /'phan zel rin chen la lta yi/ /mgal dum la ni su zhig dpyod/ /bstod pas dga' bar mi 'gyur la/ /smad pas mi dgar mi 'gyur zhing / /rang gi yon tan legs gnas pa/ /skye bo dam pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ /16

da wa saskyalegs bko kyi rtsa ba/sdig pa dang ni mthu rtsal las/ /byung ba'i longs spyod longs spyod min/ /khyi dang byi la 'grangs na yang / /ngo tsha bor ba'i rnam thar yin/ /'khor la phun sum tshogs gyur na/ /rje dpon nyid kyi che ba yin/ /rta la rgyan du byas pa de/ / bdag po nyid la mi mdzes sam /ji lta ji ltar rje dpon gyis/ /'khor la drin gyis bskyangs gyur pa/ /de lta de ltar 'khor g.yog rnams/ /rje dpon nyid kyi bya ba bsgrub/ /bdag nyid chen po gnas pa'i sar /mkhas pa gzhan dag su yis brtsi/ /mkha' la nyi ma shar ba na/ /17

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyu skar mang yang mthong mi 'gyur/ /rab tu zud pha gsum pa/ blun po 'artag pa/skye bo ngan pa 'byor thob kyang / /lhag par spyod pa ngan par 'gyur/ /'bab chu ji ltar bzlog gyur kyang / /thur du 'bab pa kho nar 'dod/ /dman la spyod pa bzang byung yang / /de ni bcos ma'i rnam thar yin/ /shel la nor bus kha bsgyur yang / /chu dang 'phrad na rang mdog ston/ /blun pos bya ba legs grub kyang / /stes dbang yin gyi bsgrubs pas min/ /srin bu'i kha chu dar skud du/ /'gro ba mkhas nas byung ba min/ /18

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/chen pos 'bad nas bsgrubs pa'i gros/ /ngan pas skad cig gcig la 'joms/ /zhing bas lo zlar 'bad pa'i zhing / /ser bas skad cig rdul du rlog /ngan pa phal cher rang gi skyon/ /gang yin gzhan la dgod par byed/ /khwa tas mi gtsang zos pa'i mchu/ /sa gtsang gzhan la 'bad nas 'phyid/ /blun po bya ba la sbyar na/ /don nyams de yang nyams par 'gyur/ /wa skyes rgyal bor bskos pa yis /'khor sdug rang yang bsad ces grags/ /rmongs pa bde ba 'dod bzhin du/ /bya ba sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig sgrub/ /gdon gyis btab pa'i skye bo 'ga'/ /19

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sdug bsngal spang phyir lcebs pa mthong / /blo ngan drang bo la las rang / /brlag 'gyur la las gzhan la gnod/ /nags kyi shing drang rtsad nas gcod/ /mda' yi drang bos pha rol gsod/ /rtag tu gzhan don mi sems pa/ /de yi spyod pa phyugs dang mtshungs/ /bza' btung 'ba' zhig dud 'gros kyang / /bsgrub par nus pa ma yin nam/ /phan dang mi phan mi dpyod cing / /blo dang thos pa mi sgrub par/ /lto 'grangs 'ba' zhig don gnyer ba/ /spu med pa yi phag pa yin/ / glun po'i dbus na dga' zhing rtse/ /20

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/mkhas pa'i mdun na zhum zhing 'dzur/ /nog dang lkog shal med na yang / /ya so can gyi ba lang yin/ /gang na bza' btung yod der rgyug /dgos pa'i bya ba bcol yang 'bros/ /gtam dang bzhad gad shes na yang / /mjug ma med pa'i khyi rgan yin/ /rmig rjes chu yis dgang sla ste/ /mdzod chung nor gyis dgang bar sla/ /zhing chung sa bon gdab sla ste/ /blo chung rig pa mgu ba sla/ /dregs bcas blun po khas len can/ /chen po yin yang nyams par 'gyur/ /gom pa gang gi sa byin pas/ /stobs ldan gyis ni sa gsum shor/ /21

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blo chung sems la khon 'dzin can/ /gnod pa bas kyang rnam 'gyur snga/ /khyi ngan dgra bo mthong na yang / /rmugs pa'i thog mar ku co 'don/ /blun pos bsags pa'i sdug bsngal nyid/ /myong gi spyod pa'i bde mi myong / /yang yang nyul zhing lta ba yi/ /'jungs pa'i nor ni byi ba 'dra/ /blun po'i drung du mkhas pa bas /spre'u 'dzin pa khyad par 'phags/ /spre'u 'dzin zas dang nor gyis mchod/ /mkhas pa lag pa stong bar 'gro/ /yon tan med pa'i skye bo rnams/ /yon tan can la lhag par sdang / /gangs kyi yul du dgun skyes pa'i/ /22

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/lo tog ltas ngan yin zhes sgrogs/ /yon tan log par sbyangs pa 'ga'/ /legs par sbyangs pa khyad du gsod/ /lba ba med na gling phran 'gar/ /yan lag nyams pa'i skyon du byed/ /cho ga nyams par byed pa rnams/ /cho ga tshang bar byed la brnyas/ /tsu ta'i yul du phyin pa na/ /rkang gnyis pa la mir mi brtsi/ /cho ga log par bsgrub pa 'ga'/ /yang dag cho ga byed la gshe /skyes bu khyi yi mgo can rnams/ /bzhin bzang bud med yin zhes brnyas/ /log 'tsho'i zas nor rnyed pa 'ga'/ /23

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mkhas pa dbul bo khyad du gsod/ /spre'u rgan rnams kyis mi bzung nas/ /mjug ma med ces bzhad gad byed/ /des na las kyis mnar bas na/ /mkhas pa blun po'i nang du 'khyam/ /rlung gis bdas pa'i ma li ka /dri zhim phyag bdar khrod na rdzi/ /skyon rnams 'bad pas 'dzin byed cing / /yon tan rtsa nas mi chags pa/ /skyes bu ngan pa chu tshags bzhin/ /ngan pa 'dzin gyi bzang bo 'chor /legs nyes dpyod pa'i blo gros med/ /mkhas pa'i mdun sar phyir phyogs spod/ /zas nor kho na'i gtam gyis 'da'/ /rkang gnyis pa yi phyugs su bshad/ /24

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/blo chung mang du 'dus na yang / /bya ba chen po sgrub mi nus/ /rtsi rkyang mang du bsdoms na yang / /khang ba'i gdung ma bzod par dka'/ /ma dpyad pa las don grub pa/ /byung yang mdzangs par su zhig rtsi/ /srin bu dag gis zos pa'i rjes/ /yi ger byung yang yig mkhan min/ /blo gros zhan pa'i 'dod gtam dang / /cang shes min pa'i rta mchog dang / /g.yul ngor lhung ba'i ral gri rnams/ /su yi grogs 'gyur nges pa med/ /shes rab med pa'i blun po rnams/ /mang yang dgra yi dbang du 'gro/ /glang chen stobs ldan khyur longs pa/ /25

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ri bong blo ldan gcig gis btul/ /shes rab med pa'i longs spyod kyang / /phal cher rang la phan pa nyung / /'dod 'jo ba yi 'o ma yang / /be'us 'thung ba brgya lam yin/ /blun po rnams kyis mkhas pa yang / /mchod par 'gyur ba'i nges slopa med/ /nyi ma shin tu 'od gsal yang / /'byung bo'i gdon rnams mi 'bros sam/ /blun po longs spyod gsog rnams la/ /gnyen gyi bsam pa ga la yod/ /sdig sdug gtam ngan kho na yis/ /byi ba bzhin du bsags nas 'chi/ /skye bo ngan pa'i tshogs nang du/ /26

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/yon tan ldan yang ga la 'khur/ /sbrul gdug gnas pa'i sa phyogs su/ /sgron me gsal yang 'od mi 'byin/ /longs spyod yod kyang las ngan gyis/ /'jungs pas spyod pa'i rang dbang med/ /rgun 'brum smin pa za ba'i tshe/ /khu la mchu nad rgyun du 'byung / /rgyun du gzhan gyis bskyang dgos pa'i/ /skye bo nam zhig ci nas nyams/ /bya rog gis ni bzung ba yi/ /rus sbal sa la lhung zhes grags/ /bzang ngan mi shes drin byas brjed/ /ngo mtshar gtam la mtshar mi 'dzin/ /mngon sum mthong ba slar yang 'dri/ /zhum zhing rjes 'brang blun po'i rtags/ / 27

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/drod chung kha yis dgra bo 'dul/ /rgyang nas mthong na ca co 'byin/ /'thab sar 'phrad na thal mo sbyor/ /rang khyim slebs na nga rgyal smra/ /sdar ma gros byed tshe na dpa'/ /khral bskos pa na nor rtsis 'debs/ /'gro dgos byung na nad bu ldang / /'thab sar rgyang nas 'bod cing bsgo/ /blo chung cung zad rgyal bas ngoms/ /gal te pham na gnyen la 'khang / /gros la 'tshogs na 'thab rtsod slong / /gsang gros byas na lkog tu smra/ /g.yul ngor rgyan la byi dor byed/ /dgra dang 'phrad na rang phyogs sbed/ /'grogs na dgra bas gnyen phyogs 'jigs/ /28

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/mtshon cha dgra yi lag char 'phen/ /dpung tshogs 'gro na mjug sdud la/ /ldog na de yi sna 'dren byed/ /bza' btung mthong na nan gyis 'jug /dka' ba mthong na thabs kyis 'byol/ /skye bo ngan pa'i mtshan nyid la/ /brjod rgyu du ma yod mod kyang / /ngan bskyugs khron pa su zhig slong / /bskyugs pa mkhas pa su zhig myong / /mchu skyod pa yis brda sprod cing / /smos pa'i tshe na mig tshums byed/ /rnam thar thos na 'khun 'chor ba/ /gang la byung yang tha shal rtags/ /29

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tuzud pa baji ba/ spel ma brtag pa/dman pa longs spyod che na yang / /rigs ldan rgud pas zil gyis gnon/ /bkres pa stag gi ngar sgra yis/ /spre'u shing gi rtse las lhung / /blun po'i yon tan khar 'byin te/ /mkhas pa'i yon tan khong du sbed/ /sog ma chu yi steng na 'phyo/ /nor bu steng du bzhag kyang 'bying / /yon tan chung rnams nga rgyal che/ /mkhas par gyur na dul bar gnas/ /chu phran rtag tu ku co che/ /rgya mtsho ca co ga la sgrogs/ /30

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/skye bo dman rnams dam pa la/ /khyad gsod byed kyi dam pas min/ /seng ges wa tshogs legs skyong gi /wa nyid wa yi rigs la 'gran/ /dam pa khros kyang btud na zhi/ /dman rnams btud na lhag par rengs/ /gser dngul sra yang bzhu nus kyi / /khyi lud bzhus na dri ngan 'byung / /mkhas la yon tan kun ldan te/ /blun la skyon rnams 'ba' zhig yin/ /rin po che las dgos dgu 'byung / /sbrul gdug las ni nyes kun skyed/ /sdig spyod nags na gnas kyang nyams/ /dam pa grong na gnas kyang dul/ /nags kyi gcan gzan khro ba dang / /31

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rta mchog grong gnas dul bar mthong / /skyes mchog rang gi skyon la lta/ / skye bo ngan pa gzhan skyon 'tshol/ /rma bya rang gi lus la rtog /srin bya gzhan la ltas ngan gtong / /dam pa dul bas rang gzhan skyong / /ngan pa rengs pas rang gzhan sdug /'bras ldan shing gis rang gzhan bsrung / /shing skam rengs pas rang gzhan sreg /'byor ba'i dus na thams cad gnyen/ /gal te rgud na kun kyang dgra/ /rin chen gling du ring nas 'du/ /mtsho bskams pa na su yang spong / /blun po 'byor ba thob na bde/ /32

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/skyes mchog thams cad byin na bde/ /mdze can phrugs na bde bar 'dzin/ /mkhas pa mdze la 'jigs par lta/ /che la gnod byed grogs su 'gyur/ /dman la gnod byed gnod par 'gyur/ /nags me rlung gis sbor mod kyi/ /de yis sgron me chung ngu gsod/ /'di bshes 'di ni dgra bo zhes/ /blo gros chung rnams so sor 'byed/ /blo chen kun la byams pa la/ /phan byed gang yin nges pa med/ /yon tan ldan pa yon tan la/ /dga' yi yon tan med rnams min/ /sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa me tog la/ /dga' yi sha sbrang de lta min/ /33

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nang na mjes/ / blun pos mkhas pa ji ltar go /tsan dan gser bas rin che la/ /blun pos sol bar byas la ltos/ /mkhas pa rang gis dpyod shes kyi/ /blun po grags pa'i rjes su 'brang / /khyi rgan ku co 'don pa na/ /rgyu mtshan med par gzhan dag rgyug /mkhas pa shin tu rgud na yang / /legs bshad gtam gyis gzhan dga' byed/ /blun po 'byor bar gyur tshe yang / /rtsod pa kho nas rang gzhan sreg /kha cig smra bas grub par rtsi/ / la la mi smra don la 'bad/ /khyi ngan dgra la khus 'debs te/ /34

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/chu skyar byi la sgra med 'jab/ /dam pa rgol yang phan pa sgrub/ /skye bo ngan pa mdza' yang gnod/ /lha rnams khro bas sems can srung / /gshin rje 'dzum yang pha rol gsod/ /skye bo dam pa rin chen bzhin/ /rnam pa kun tu 'gyur ldog med/ /skye bo ngan pa srang mda' bzhin/ /cung zad tsam gyis mtho dma' byed/ /blo mthun ring na gnas kyang phan/ /mi mthun nye na lhag par 'bral/ /'dam skyes 'dam gyis mi gos la/ /de nyid nyi mas rtag tu skyong / /ji srid ngo tsha yod gyur pa/ /35

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da wa de srid yon tan rgyan gyi mchog /ngo tsha brgal na yon tan nyid/ /phyogs su byas te gtam ngan 'phel/ /dam pa ma bcol legs par ston/ /dman la dris kyang log par bshad/ /rgyal ba'i sras la brnyas kyang brtse/ /'chi bdag mchod kyang gsod pa yin/ /gcig la phan par 'gyur ba yi/ /bya ba gzhan la gnod pa srid/ /zla ba shar na ku mu da/ /kha 'byed 'gyur gyi padmo zum/ /nyes pa la las don grub pa/ /byung yang mkhas rnams ga la smon/ /legs par bsgrubs kyang skyon srid mod/ /de la mkhas rnams khrel ba med/ /36

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rnyed pa la la rnyed pa ste/ /rnyed pa la la dgra bo yin/ /rgod ma mngal ldan nor 'phel byed/ /dre'u mo sbrum na 'chi ba rnyed/ /dam pa dbye dka' 'dum sla ste/ /dman pa dbye sla 'dum pa dka'/ /ljon shing dang ni sol ba yi/ /gcad dang sbyor ba'i khyad par ltos/ /nyam chung gyur kyang zon byed na/ /chen po yis kyang gzhom par dka'/ /chen po yin yang bag phebs na/ /nyam chung rnams kyis brlag pa mang / /nor gyis 'byor na stobs kyang 'phel/ /nor med pa la stobs kyang 'bri/ /byi ba dbyig ldan nor phrogs pas/ /37

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rku ba'i nus pa nyams zhes thos/ /mi gang bsod nams la spyod pa/ /btang yang longs spyod char bzhin 'bab/ /bsod nams med pa'i longs spyod de/ /bsags kyang su yis za ba soms/ /dam pa re zhig rgud gyur kyang / / —zla ba bzhin du yar ngo 'byung / /dman pa lan cig rgud gyur na/ /mar me bzhin du mnal bar 'gyur/ /shes ldan dgra la mig bsrings pas/ /tha mar dgra bo dbang du sdud/ /drod chung dgra la lan byas pas/ /dka' ba rgyun mi 'chad pa thob/ /mkhas pa shin tu nyam nga ba'i/ /38

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/gnas la 'dzur na dpa' rtags yin/ /seng ges khyu mchog gsod pa'i tshe/ /rwa la 'dzur ba ga la sdar/ /rnam pa kun tu mi dpyod par/ /dgra la mchong ba blun rtags yin/ /mar me'i 'od la 'dzings pa yis/ /sbrang bu dpa' bar 'gro'am ci/ /ngan pa rang rten khyad par 'joms/ /dam pa gang la brten pa srung / /srin bu rang rten zad zad za/ /seng ge rang gi yul 'khor srung / /dman rnams dgos pa chung ngu gsang / /gsang dgos dgos pa med par smra/ /dmarkepa dgos med gsang mi 'gyur/ /gsang dgos srog la babs kyang srung / /39

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/dman pa 'byor na dregs rgyu ste/ /dam pa 'byor na dul ba'i rgyu/ /wa skyes 'grangs na dregs pas brgyal/ /seng ge 'grangs na bde bar nyal/ /dam pa dang ni dman pa yi/ /spyod pa gnyis ka goms pa'i shugs/ /bung ba me tog 'tshol ba dang / /ngang ba chur 'jug bslab ci dgos/ /rgyal ngan dgra dang phrad pa na/ /rang gi 'khor la chad pas gcod/ /don ma grub pa'i blun po 'ga'/ /rang nyid 'gegs te 'chi ba yod/ / chos rgyal dgra dang phrad pa na/ /lhag par 'khor la byams pa skye/ /na ba'i bu la khyad par du/ /40

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/ma ni gdung ba skye bar 'gyur/ /skye bo dam pa ngan pa dang / / 'grogs na ngan pa'i shan du 'gyur/ /gang gā'i chu ni rab zhim pa/ /rgya mtshor slebs na ba tshwar 'gyur/ /dman pas skye bo mchog bsten na/ /skye bo dam pa'i spyod pa 'byung / /gla rtsis byugs pa'i gang zag la/ /gla rtsi'i dri zhim 'byung la ltos/ /lhun po cis kyang mi 'gul ba/ /de bzhin bdag nyid chen po brtan/ /shing bal chung ngu g.yo ba ltar/ /dman pa'i spyod pa 'gyur ldog che/ /41

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rab tuzud pa lja ba/ nganabhyod brtag pa/g.yo can snyan par smra ba ni/ /rang don yin gyi gus phyir min/ /srin bya bsnyen nas dgod pa ni/ /ltas ngan gtong gi dga' nas min/ /ngan pa thog mar tshig gis 'brid/ /bag phebs gyur na phyi nas bslu/ /nya pa zas kyis kha brid nas/ /nya rnams gsod par byed la ltos/ /dman pa ji srid nyam chung ba/ /de yi bar la rang bzhin bzang / /dug gi tsher ma ma smin pa'i/ /bar du gzhan la 'bigs mi nus/ /42

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/yid la bsam pa gzhan byas nas/ /tshig tu smra ba gzhan byed na/ /g.yo can zhes su grags pa ste/ /blun po mkhas par 'chos pa yin/ /ha cang g.yo sgyu mang drags na/ /re zhig grub kyang tha mar brlag /gzig lpags bkab pa'i bong bu yis/ /lo tog zos mthar gzhan gyis bsad/ /shes rab ldan na mngon sum gyi/ /brdzun gyis pha rol slu bar nus/ /rkun po rnams kyis khyir btags pas/ /ra skyes khur ba bram zes bor/ /nyes pa mngon sum byed bzhin du/ /g.yo can tshig gis pha rol slu/ /lha chen smre sngags shor ba la/ /43

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/sdug bsngal bden pa bsgrags so lo/ /g.yo can tshul gzob ngag 'jam la/ /ma brtags bar du yid mi brtan/ /rma bya gzugs mdzes sgra snyan yang / /de yi kha zas dug chen yin/ /g.yo can bzang bo'i tshul bzung na/ /phyi nas don la slu ba yod/ /ri dwags rnga ma bstan nas ni/ /khrel 'das bong bu'i sha dag 'tshong / /ngo tsha chung rnams gzhan nor la/ /bdag gi che ba sgrub pa yod/ /mgron la grogs po'i gos bting nas/ /bdag gi gus rtags ston par byed/ /gting nas nyams pa'i khrel 'das rnams/ /yo

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rang gi gtam ngan ngo sor 'khyer/ /kañtsa'i yul gyi rgyal rigs 'ga'/ /pha bsad pa la rgyal rnga rdung / /blo chung rnams kyis phan btags pa/ /'ga' zhig gnod pa chen por 'gyur/ /skya ka'i phru gus ma yi spu/ /'thog pa drin lan yin par sgom/ /gzhung ngan gzhan gyi bka' drin las/ /byung ba rang gi che bar sgom/ /klu yis 'bad nas phab pa'i char /zhing ba rang gi dpal du rtsi/ /blo ngan las la spyod pa la/ /rang gi 'bad pas thob par sems /khyi rgan ya rkan phug pa'i khrag /rus pa'i bcud du bsgoms nas 'cha'/ /45

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi mkhas pa dag gnyen bcom nas/ /'brel med gzhan dag gso bar mthong / /mgo bo bcad nas mjug ma'i rgyan/ /smyon pa min pa su zhig byed/ /blun pos dgos pa'i sar mi phyin/ /mi dgos pa la lhag par 'chor/ /chu mig ngan pa dbyar 'bab kyi/ /dpyid dus dgos pa'i tshe na skam/ /skye bo dam pa zhi ba la/ /ngan pa lhag par 'tshe bar byed/ /snum dang ldan pa'i sdong bu la/ /me lce 'chags kyi gzhan la min/ /rtsub pas rtsub pa thul 'gyur gyi/ /zhi bas 'dul bar ga la nus/ /phol mig bsregs dang bcad pas gdon/ /46

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/zhi chos de yi dug tu 'gyur/ /rgyal bos chos bzhin sa bskyang ste/ /min na rgyal bo nyams pa'i rtags/ /nyi mas mun pa mi sel na/ /de ni gza' yis zin pa'i rtags/ /sdig spyod rje bor bskos pa dang / /khang ba'i yang thog grum pa dang / /ri rtse shin tu zhig pa yi/ /'og tu gnas rnams rgyun du skrag /gal te rig pa yod na yang / /skye bo rang bzhin ngan pa spang / /dug sbrul nor bus mgo brgyan yang / /mkhas pa su zhig pang du len/ /bsnyen drags rgyal bo bzhed bzhin dka'/ /47

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bkyed na thugs kyis 'dzin pa dkon/ /bar mar gnas pa g.yang za bas /rgyal bo la la me chen 'dra/ /chung ma ngan dang mdza' bo ngan/ /rgyal bo ngan pa su zhig bsten/ /gcan gzan gdug pa'i nags khrod du/ /sems shes rtag tu sdod dam ci/ /dregs pas yon tan nyams 'gyur zhing / /'dod pas ngo tsha nyams par byed/ /g.yog 'khor rtag tu sun phyung na/ /rje dpon nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ /phan par smra ba dkon pa ste/ /de dag bas kyang nyan pa dkon/ /sman pa mkhas pa rnyed dka' ste/ /de yi tshig bzhin byed pa nyung / /48

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/ha cang rlom pa che drags na/ /sdug bsngal brgyud mar thog tu 'bab/ /seng ge nga rgyal ches pa'i rgyus/ /wa yis khur bu bskur zhes thos/ /bya rog dag gis bskungs pa dang / /gzhung ngan pa la phan btags dang / /zhing ngan sa bon btab pa rnams/ /re ba mang ste spyod pa nyung / /ma brtags par ni su la yang /yid ches pa dang bsgo mi bya/ /bag phab pa las skyon byung dang / /gros btab pa las dgrar gyur mang / /'jig rten ngan pa mang yod kyang / /skye bo ngan 'dra'i 'jigs pa med/ /ngan pa gzhan dag bcos rung gi /49

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ skye bo ngan pa bcos na 'jig /skye bo ngan pa yon tan brgyas/ /phan par byas kyang mgu mi nus/ /gang zhig bsten pa dgrar 'gyur 'di/ /skye bo ngan pa'i khyad chos yin/ /ngan pa ji ltar bcos gyur kyang / /rang bzhin bzang bo 'byung mi srid/ /sol ba 'bad de bkrus na yang / /kha dog dkar ba mi srid do/ /skye bo ngan pas sun phyung ba'i/ /sa der dam pa mthong yang spong / /sbrul gyis gtses pa'i sa phyogs su/ /gser gyi nyag thag mthong yang 'bros/ /mchod pa dam pa la bya yi/ /50

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/dman pa mchod na nyes pa'i gzhi/ /'o ma skyes bu'i bdud rtsi ste/ /sbrul la byin na dug 'phel lo/ /'bad de kun nas bsten byas kyang / /ngan pa blo dang ga la 'dres/ /mchil ba ji ltar gsos gyur kyang / /bag phebs 'gyur ba mi srid do/ / rtag tu 'byed la brtson pa'i mis/ /mdza' ba brtan po'ang phyed 'gyur te/ /chu yis rtag tu bcos gyur na/ /brag la ser ga mi 'byung ngam/ /bdag gis bslus dang ngan byas dang / /mkhan slob grogs kyi skyon brjod pa/ /brdzun na brdzun pas yid brtan med/ /bden na lhag par 'jigs pa skye/ /51

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi gang brjod bya ma yin pa/ /gzhan gyi drung du sus brjod pa/ /bden nam 'on te brdzun kyang rung / /mkhas pas de la bag zon bya/ / gzhung ngan nor la gces 'dzin pa/ /mdza' bshes yin yang yid mi brtan/ /chen po rnams la gsug zos nas/ /gnyen gyis brlag par byas pa mang / /gnod pa'i mtshan ma khar 'byin pa'i/ /dgra bo de dag gzhom par sla/ /phan pa'i bzlog rtags khar 'byin pa'i/ /dgra bo de dag ji ltar gzhom/ /rma gzhan mkhas na 'tsho srid kyi/ /nyes pa'i tshig rma 'drub pa med/ /khā yis 'ug pa sma phab pas/ /52

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/bskal ba'i bar du 'gras la ltos/ /snying la 'khon du dam bzung nas/ /kha la tshig bzang smra 'o zhes/ /drang srong gdug pa'i gdams ngag ste/ /dam pa'i tshul dang 'gal ba yin/ /dug gi rtsa ba 'don pa ltar/ /dgra bo rtsad nas gcod do zhes/ /rgyal bo'i lugs las 'byung mod kyi/ /bu bzhin bskyangs na bu bzhin byed/ /rang don 'ba' zhig sgrub pa yi/ /mi dang 'grogs par su yis nus/ /so nam brtson pa'i zhing gseb tu/ /ldum gzhan smin pa'i go skabs dka'/ /mi gang byas pa mi gzo ba/ /

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de la grogs byed ga la srid/ /'bad kyang 'bras bu mi smin pa'i/ /zhing la so nam su yis nus/ /gzu lums dag gis spyod pa yis/ /skye bo myur du rgud par 'gyur/ /spyi brtol can gyi glang rgod kyis/ /gcad bya myur du mi gcod dam/ /dman la ji ltar phar byin yang / /tshur la dgos na ga la ster/ /skam pas rtag tu bzung na yang / /lcags gong tshur la 'dzin nam ci/ /ngan pas gzhan don sgrub bo zhes/ /snyad btags nas ni sdig la sbyor/ /gzhan don ltar snang bsgrub don du/ /mkhas pa su zhig rang nyid 'joms/ /54

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/bu lon lhag ma dgra bo'i thed/ /khrims ngan rnams dang gtam ngan dang / /rigs rgyud ngan dang spyod ngan rnams/ /ma spel bar yang rang nyid 'phel/ /rab tubyed pa drug pa/ rang bzhin gyi tshul brtag pa/bdag nyid dpon du bskos gyur na/ /de yi bya ba shes pa dkon/ /gzhan la lta ba'i mig yod kyang / /rang nyid lta na me long dgos/ /shes rab phyogs gcig ldan pas kyang / /bya ba kun la mkhas pa dka'/ /shin tu gsal ba'i mig gis kyang / /sgra la nyan par nus ma yin/ /55

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/drang bor smra ba skyon bcas dang / /'khyog smra yon tan ldan pa srid/ /lam drang 'ga' zhig nor 'jigs la/ /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil bkra shis byed/ /bsod nams med na yon tan 'ga'/ /yon tan nyid kyis rang nyid 'joms/ /mu tig 'dzin pa'i nya phyis rnams/ /mu tig nyid kyis srog dang 'bral/ /yon tan ldan yang bsten drags na/ /phal cher skyo ba skye ba srid/ /bur shing shin tu zhim pa yang / /rgyun du bsten na phal cher 'dor/ /rang bzhin bzang bo rnams la yang / /rgyun du gtses na gnod sems skye/ /tsan dan bsil ba yin mod kyi/ /56

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/gtsub par gyur na 'bar bar 'gyur/ /rgyal bo shin tu mang mod kyi/ /chos bzhin skyong ba shin tu nyung / /mkha' la lha gnas mang na yang / /'od gsal nyi zla lta bu med/ /gang zhig gnod pa byed nus pa/ /de yis phan par byed par nus/ /mgo bo gcod par nus pa yi/ /rgyal bos rgyal srid sbyin par nus/ /blon po blo ldan drang bo yis/ /rje dang 'bangs kyi don kun 'grub/ /mda' drang mkhas pas 'phangs gyur na/ /gang la gtad par 'phog pa yin/ /rgyal bo nyid kyis ma brtsis na/ /57

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/thams cad shes pa'ang bkur mi 'gyur/ /srog gi dbang bos ma bzung ba'i/ /mi ro bzang yang su zhig len/ / mang bo gcig tu blo mthun na/ /nyam chung gis kyang don chen 'grub/ /srog chags grog ma'i tshogs 'dus pas/ /seng ge'i phru gu bsad ces grags/ /zhum bcas rtsol ba dor ba'i mi /mthu stobs ldan yang rgud par 'gyur/ /glang bo shin tu stobs ldan yang / /glang rdzi chung ngus bran bzhin 'khol/ /nga rgyal rtsol ba cher bskyed na/ /chen po rnams kyang zil gyis gnon/ /dung dkar shin tu lus chung yang / /chu srin chen po'i gshed ma yin/ /58

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/chen pos nga rgyal bya mi dgos/ /ngan pas nga rgyal byas ci phan/ /rin chen tshig gis bsgrag mi dgos/ /mching bu baṣpegs kyang su zhig nyo/ /bdag nyid chen po'i 'byor ba rtag /skyes ngan phun tshogs rgud la nye/ /nyi ma rgyun du 'od 'byin te/ /zla ba nya bar gyur nas 'bri/ /rgyal bos go 'phang bstod drags na/ /de yi tha ma brlag pa'i rgyu/ /sgo nga mkha' la 'phangs gyur na/ /chag pa nyid las gzhan ci 'byung / /skye bo phal cher rang nyid dang / /mthun pa'i rigs kyis gnod pa skyel/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer shar ba na/ /59

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'od zer can gzhan brlag par 'gyur/ /phan byed dgra bo yin yang bsten/ /gnyen yang gnod na spang bar bya/ /rgya mtsho'i nor bu rin gyis nyo/ /khong ba'i zug rngu sman gyis 'byin/ /nang du cung zad 'byor gyur na/ /phyi ru dregs pa'i rnam 'gyur ston/ /chu yis yongs su gang ba'i tshe/ /sprin rnams g.yo zhing 'brug sgra sgrogs/ /yon tan kun ldan dkon pa ltar/ /yon tan ci yang med pa'ang dkon/ /skyon dang yon tan 'dres pa las /yon tan gtso che mkhas pas bsten/ /dang po nyid nas dgra bo dang / /60

——da ——sdid — saskyalegasabashadakyirtsabade/ mdza' bo nyid du nges pa med/ /kha zas ma zhu dug tu 'gyur/ /dug kyang shes na sman du 'gyur/ / ༄gang na las mthun yod de 'byor/ /las kyi 'du 'phrod med der rgud/ /khyim du bzung yang mi chags pa'i/ /ngang ba mtsho las bskrad kyang 'khor/ /mkhas rnams rig pa yon gyis slob/ /blun po rig pa bslabs kyang spong / / phal cher na la sman za yang /la la gson po lceb pa yod/ /rang dbang thams cad bde ba ste/ /gzhan dbang thams cad sdug bsngal yin/ /thun mong ba ni rtsod gzhi ste/ /dam bcas pa ni 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /61

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nang na yon tan kun ldan yang / /cha lugs ngan na kun gyis brnyas/ /pags bye'u mkhas kyang spu med pas/ /'dab chags kun gyis spang zhes grags/ /gnas min ha cang drang bo yang /rang gzhan gnyis ka brlag pa yod/ /mda' yis pha rol gsod pa'am/ /yang na rang nyid 'chag par 'gyur/ /char dang chu bo rgya mtshor 'bab /blo dang rig pa mkhas la 'go /nor dang skye bo rgyal bos sdud/ /dro zhing brlan par nags tshal skye/ /dbyar gyi chu mig rtswa yi me/ /sprin bar nyi ma zla ba nya/ /blo ngan rig pa ngan dang mdza'/ /62

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/dgos tshe 'byung ba'i nges pa med/ /blun pos smra ba nyung na mdzes/ /rgyal bo lkog tu 'dug na mdzes/ /sgyu ma brgya lam mthong na mdzes/ /nor chen dkon na rin thang che/ / ciha cang byams pa che drags na/ /de nyid 'khon pa'i rgyu ru 'gyur/ /'jig rten rtsod pa phal cher ni/ /'brel ba nyid las 'byung ba mang / /shin tu rtsod pa chen po yang / /lhag par mdza' ba'i rgyu srid de/ /rtsod pa byung ba'i mtha' phal cher /'dum par gyur pa mang bar mthong / /ser sna can gyi nor rnams dang / /63

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phrag dog can gyi grogs po dang / /blo ngan gyi ni rig pa rnams/ /yod kyang dga' ba bskyed mi nus/ /rkam chags can ni nor gyis dga'/ /nga rgyal can ni bstod pas mgu /blun po rang dang mthun pas dga'/ /dam pa bden par smra bas mgu /skye bo ngan pa'i yon tan dang / /smra spobs zhan pa'i rig pa dang / /rje dpon ngan pa'i bka' drin rnams/ /gzhan la phan pa'i go skabs dka'/ /gang la nor yod smra ba mdzes/ /nor med smra ba bden yang spong / /ma la ya las byung gyur na/ /sdong dum phal la'ang rin thang che/ /64

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/smra mang nyes pa 'dzin pa'i rgyu/ /mi smra nyes pa spong ba'i gzhi/ /ne tso smra bas gzeb tu bcug /'dab chags lkugs pa bde bar rgyu/ /mi gang dgra la g.yo med pas/ /rnam pa kun tu phan btags na/ /dgra yang de la g.yo med pas/ /'dud pa dngos po'i che ba yin/ /stobs bral mi yis khros ci phan/ /stobs ldan don la khro ci dgos/ / des na bya ba sgrub pa la/ /khro ba don med rang sreg yin/ /sbyin pas bsdus na dgra yang 'du/ /sbyin med gnyen yang ring du spong / /65

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ba yi 'o ma zad pa na/ /be'u bzung yang 'chor bar 'gyur/ /bya ba 'ga' la mkhas pa yis/ /gzhan dag shes pa'i nges pa med/ /chu las 'o ma 'byed shes pa'i/ /ngang bas gzags brnyan zas su sgom/ /༄rtag tu byams pas skyong ba yi/ /rje bos bran g.yog rnyed par sla/ /padma'i mtsho la ngang ba dag /ma bsdus par yang ngang gis 'du/ /longs spyod ldan pas spyod pa dang / /mkhas par gyur nas dul ba dang / /chen pos dman pa legs skyong ba/ /gsum po gzhan bde rang la phan/ /66

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/bsod nams shugs kyis don bsgrub pa/ /nyi ma'i 'od bzhin ltos pa med/ /'bad pa'i shugs kyis don bsgrub pa/ /mar me'i 'od bzhin kun la ltos/ /chen po rnams la rten bcas na/ /dman pa rnams kyang chen po thob/ /ljon shing che la brten pa yis/ /'khril shing rtse mor phyin la ltos/ /yon tan ldan la skyon yod kyang / /yon tan dga' rnams nye bar bsten/ / char gyis mkhar la gnod na yang / /'jig rten pa rnams dga' ba bskyed/ /yon tan med na cha lugs kyis/ /mkhas rnams dga' ba bskyed mi nus/ /rta mchog 'gros dang mi ldan na/ /67

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ —da wa shin tu barming yang rin thang chung / /nor ldan blun po'i nang na mang / /dpa' bo gcan gzan khrod na mod/ /legs bshad mkhas pa'i khrod 'byin pa/ /dam pa 'jig rten 'di na dkon/ /gang dang gang la de yod pa/ /de yis de yi grags pa thob /mkhas pa'i grags pa mkhas pa dang / /dpa' bos dpa' bo thos pa bzhin/ /chen po rnams kyis mchod bya ba/ /dman pa rnams kyis brnyas par 'gyur/ /dbang phyug chen po'i spyi bo'i rgyan/ /zla ba lha min zas su byed/ /rig pa glegs bam la gnas dang / /68

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/ma bsgrubs pa yi gsang sngags dang / /brjed ngas can gyi bslab pa rnams/ /dgos pa'i tshe na slu ba mang / /blo ldan nor gyis 'byor na yang / /le lo can la mthon po dka'/ /rna ba thog mar skyes na yang / /rwa rtse mtho ba ma mthong ngam/ /khyi phag rnams la dri zhim dang / /dmus long ba la sgron me dang / /ma zhu ba la kha zas dang / /blun po rnams la chos ci dgos/ /yon tan can dang gser bzang bo/ /g.yul ngor dpa' dang rta bzang bo/ /sman pa mkhas dang rgyan bzang bo/ /gang du phyin pa de ru brin/ /69

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blo dang brtson 'grus yod gyur pa/ /de yis bsgrub par mi nus gang / /sgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis po/ /skya seng bu yis bcom zhes thos/ /phal cher bu tsha'i spyod pa ni/ /rigs rgyud snga ma'i rjes su 'brang / /khu byug phru gu bye'u khra ru/ /'gro ba brgya lam srid pa tsam/ /ri dang chu bo glang bo rta/ /shing dang 'od zer nor bu rdo/ /skyes pa bud med rigs gcig kyang / /mchog dang dman pa'i khyad par yod/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i tshig tsam yang nyam chung rnams kyis bzod par dka'/ /go ḍa'i rgyal bo'i tshig tsam gyis/ /70

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rgya mtsho'i rgyal bo bcings zhes grags/ /bya ba 'bad nas kun bsgrubs kyang / /'grub pa bsod nams shugs la rag /tshong pas rgya mtshor ma rnyed pa'i/ /nor bu rgyal bo'i mdzod na spyod/ /blun po'i byams sdang rtags kyis go /sgrin po'i byams sdang rgas kyis go /khyi rgan 'dzum na dga' rtags te/ /gshin rje 'dzum na gsod pa'i rtags/ /nor gyi mchog ni sbyin pa ste/ /bde ba'i mchog ni sems skyid pa/ /rgyan gyi mchog ni thos pa ste/ /grogs po'i mchog ni mi slu ba'o/ /nor gyis ma gdung su zhig yin/ /71

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rtag tu bde bar bsdad pa su/ /bde dang sdug bsngal thams cad kyang / /dbyar dgun bzhin du brje bar 'gyur/ /nyam chung rnams kyis chen po'i ming / /bzung ba tsam la gzhan gyis bsrung / /sor mo'i phreng ba'i ming bzung bas/ /log 'dren phal gyis bsrung bar bshad/ /sems can gang dang gang 'brel ba/ /bya ba sngon gyi las kyis byed/ /bya rgod 'phyi ba khur ba dang / /sram gyis 'ug pa mchod la ltos/ /longs spyod gsog par 'dod rnams kyis/ /'phel na gtong ba bsrung ba'i mchog /chu chen rdzing du ldugs 'dod na/ /'brid pa bzhag pa rdzing gis gsos/ /72

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rab tu zud pa bdun pa/ mi rigs pa'i tshul dbyud pa/bran g.yog nga rgyal che ba dang / /dka' thub ldan pa chas gzob dang / /rgyal bo chos bzhin mi spyod pa/ /gsum po tshul min zhugs pa yin/ /mi lcogs bya ba rtsom pa dang / /mang dang 'khon zhing stobs ldan rtsod/ /bud med yid rton ngan dang mdza'/ /lnga bo myur du brlag pa'i rgyu/ /nor med gos bzang mchog 'dod dang / /gzhan la slong zhing nga rgyal che/ /bstan bcos mi shes rtsod par 'dod/ /gsum po 'gro ba'i bzhad gad sa/ /73

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yul bzang yod bzhin yul ngan la/ /skye bo ngan pa phongs shing chags/ /keng shu'i me tog sha yin zhes/ /ce spyang las gzhan su zhig re/ /chen po rnams la dgra bas kyang / /rang gi 'khor gyis gnod pa mang / /seng ge lus kyi 'bu min pa/ / srog chags gzhan gyis ga la za/ /rje bos bdag la gnod byed na/ /de la skyob par byed pa su/ /snang bas gzugs la sgrib byed na/ /de la lta ba'i thabs gzhan med/ /chos spyod zhi bar gnas pa la/ /'tshe byed shin tu tha shal yin / /74

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rang la skyabs 'ong bsad pa la/ /dpa' bo yin zhes su zhig sgrogs/ / dzoskye ngan rang la mi phan yang / /gzhan la gnod par byed pa yod/ /sbrul gdug zas su rlung za yang /pha rol mthong na mi gsod dam/ /'dod pa bde'osgrosnyam sems kyang / /de spyod sdug bsngal kho na'i rgyu/ /chang 'thung bde'o snyam pa de/ /smyo ba bde bar bsgom pa yin/ / yon tan can la 'jig rten gus/ /yon tan 'bad pa'i shugs la gnas/ /'bad nas yon tan mi bsgrub par/ /gzhan la 'khangs pas ci zhig phan/ /75

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mi rnams tshe ring ba la smon/ /rgas par gyur la 'jigs par lta/ /rgas la 'jigs shing tshe ring bar/ /'dod pa blun po'i log lta yin/ /gang zhig mkhas pa yod bzhin du/ /de las yon tan mi slob na/ /mi de gdon gyis btab pa'am/ /yang na las kyis mnar ba yin/ /gang la longs spyod yod bzhin du/ /spyod dam sbyin par mi byed na/ /mi de nad kyis btab pa'am/ /yang na yi dwags mngon sum yin/ /chos lugs shes kyang mi sgrub na/ /de yi chos kyis ci zhig bya/ /lo tog phun sum tshogs na yang / /76

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/gcan gzan dga' ba ga la skye/ /las kyis mnar ba'i sems can la/ /longs spyod yod kyang spyod mi nus/ /bya rog ltogs kyang bskungs mod kyi/ /'grangs par za bar ga la nus/ /spyod dam sbyin par mi nus pa'i/ /nor des phyug por bsgom na ni/ /ri bo gser du bsgoms pa yis /phyug po bsgrub pa shin tu sla/ /chos dang chos min smra ba la/ /mkhas pa shin tu mang na yang / /de ltar shes nas nyams len pa/ /'jig rten 'di na shin tu dkon/ / rigs gzugs lang tsho ldan na yang / /77

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yon tan med na mjes ma yin/ /rma bya spu sdug yid 'ong yang /chen po'i rgyan du 'os sam ci /sna yi tshab ma nyos pa'i bu/ /g.yar ba'i rgyan dang brkus pa'i nor/ /slob dpon med pa'i rig pa rnams/ /yod kyang gzhan gyis brtsi ba med/ /mi gang byas pa mi gzo ba/ /de ni gzhan pas rang la gnod/ /ltas ngan bsgrub pa nyes pa 'ga'/ /dgra yi thog mar rang la 'byung / /longs spyod 'grub par mthong na yang / /gnas ma yin las su zhig len/ /lug thug 'thab pa'i khrag bldags pas/ /wa skyes mgo bo bkas zhes thos/ /78

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/'brel ba 'ga' yi ngor byas nas/ /gzhan dag stes kyis dor mi bya/ /brgya byin yin yang 'khor 'dab rnams/ /ga bur bzhin du 'bros par 'gyur/ /rgyun du 'grogs pa'i grogs spangs nas/ /gsar bu 'ga' la yid mi brtan/ /'ug pa'i rgyal bos bya rog gi /blon po bsten pas phung zhes grags/ /mi ngan 'bad pas bsten byas kyang / /rang gi mi ru 'gro ba med/ /chu ni ji ltar bskol gyur kyang / /me ru 'bar ba mi srid do/ /rgyu mtshan brtags nas khro ba ni/ /cung zad rigs shing sel ba'ang shes/ /rgyu med par ni gang khro ba/ /79

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de yi bsal thabs su yis shes/ /dgra bo'i nus pa ma brtags par/ /nyam chung na yang brnyas mi bya/ /da ṭi bha la brnyas pa yis/ /nam mkha' lding gis rgya mtsho bcom/ /bsod nams 'dzad na ngan sems skye/ /rigs 'dzad pa na bu ngan skye/ /nor 'dzad pa na rkam chags skye/ /tshe 'dzad pa na 'chi ltas 'byung / /rang gis ngan spyod ma byas na/ /brgya byin gyis kyang smad mi nus/ /chu mig rang nyid ma bskams na/ /sa yis mnan pas ga la thub/ /bya ba mi 'dra brgya phrag rtsom/ /80

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/mthar phyin bya ba gcig kyang med/ /blo rgod phal cher grong bar gyi/ /khyi rgan 'dra bar rgyun du 'khyam/ /las kyi shugs kyis khrid pa na/ /blo chen log pa'i lam nas 'gro/ /mu stegs byed pa'i ston pa mchog /dbang phyug smyon pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin/ /mi gang khrims las gang 'da' ba/ /re zhig rgyal yang pham pa yin/ /chu skyar khrims las 'das pa yis / sa kun thob kyang seng ges bsad/ /ha cang shes rab che drags pa'i/ /bya ba mang na bdag nyid brlag /rgyal bo dran rgya ches pa yis /rgyal srid nyams pa shin tu mang / /81

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ ha cang longs spyod bsags drags pa'i/ /nor ni rang gi gshed ma yin/ /phung khrol phal cher phyug po la/ /'byung gi sprang bo bde bar rgyu/ /ha cang mthu rtsal che drags na/ /lceb pa'i sta gon byed pa yin/ /g.yul du bsad pa phal mo che/ /mthu rtsal can la byung ba mang / /'byor dang shes rab stobs la sogs/ /bsod nams ldan la grogs su 'gyur/ /bsod nams med na de dag kun/ /bdag nyid brlag pa'i rgyu ru 'gyar/ /stomakhas pas bya ba ci byed kyang / /rang gi bsod nams brtags te bya/ /rtsod dus bsod nams phun tshogs pa/ /82

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/skye bo brgya yi nang na'ang dkon/ /rdzing ngan chu yis khengs pa na/ / phyogs gcig ci nas 'jig pa ltar/ /gang la nor dang ldan gyur pa/ /de la rigs rgyud shin tu dkon/ /bu dang ldan la nor chen dkon/ /de dang ldan na dgra bos 'joms/ /thams cad phun sum tshogs gyur na/ /mi de myur du 'chi ba mang / /des na mkhas pas bsod nams gsag /bsod nams kho na bde ba'i rgyu/ /su zhig gang na phun tshogs pa/ /de ni bsod nams bsags pa'i rtags/ /rdzun gyis pha rol bslus so zhes/ /83

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/snyam na rang nyid bslus pa yin/ /lan gcig rdzun du smras pa des/ /bden pa smras kyang dogs pa skye/ /legs nyes rnam par mi dpyod par/ /— khros shing pha rol gnad 'bebs pa/ /chung ma bsad pa'i thi ba ltar/ /grogs dang bral ba'i mya ngan thob/ /ma 'ongs pa la mi dpyod par/ /byung ba'i tshe na 'bad de btsal/ /chu dang 'phrad na lham 'phud kyi/ /ma 'phrad pa nas ga la 'phud/ /phugs su bsgrub par mi nus pa'i/ /bya ba legs kyang 'jug mi rung / /khong ba'i nang du mi 'ju ba'i/ /kha zas zhim yang su zhig za/ /84

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rtsol ba dor nas 'dug pa la/ /'di phyi gnyis ka 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'bad pa med na zhing bzang yang / /lo tog thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /gnas ma yin pa'i dul drags na/ /thams cad kyis ni bsgo bar 'gyur/ /shing bal stan du byed mod kyi/ /yal ga su zhig stan du 'dings/ /bya ba ngan dang mi 'grub pa/ /pha rol bsgo yang byed na blun/ /sbyar dug nyo la su zhig rton/ /thams cad sbyin zhes sus smra nus/ /nor rnams gsog cing mi spyod pa/ /rang bsreg bud shing gsog pa yin/ /bung ba sbrang rtsi mi za bar/ /85

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gzhan gyis khyer na lceb par rtsom /rab tuzud pa brgyad pa/ byu ba brtag pa/blo ldan bya ba cung zad kyang / /rgyun du gros kyis bsgrub par bya/ /grub par gyur na lta ci smos/ /ma grub na yang mdzes pa'i rgyu/ /sems can mos pa sna tshogs pas/ /thams cad mgu bar sus kyang dka'/ /rang nyid yon tan ldan byas na/ /thams cad dga' ba de la nye/ /shin tu rgas par gyur tshe yang / /thos pa mang du bsog par bya/ /phyi mar thos pas phan pa tsam/ /sbyin pa yis kyang ga la phan/ /86

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/yon tan kun rdzogs skye bo bsten/ /yang na tha mal 'grogs pa bde/ /bum pa chu yis gang ba'am/ /yang na stong ba khur ba sla/ /yon tan cung zad bslabs pa'i mi/ /su zhig gis ni bsten par nus/ /chu phyed gang ba'i bum pa de/ /mgo la bkur ba su yis nus/ /mi gang skye bo dam pa dang / /dman pa'i khyad par legs shes nas/ /de yi bya ba bsgrub shes pa/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhi chen yin/ /blo gros ldan pas legs bskyangs na/ /skye bo dman pa'ang mchog tu 'gyur/ /slob shes dag gis ne tso la / /87

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/bslabs na 'don pa shes par 'gyur/ /nyams stobs chung ba'i skye bos kyang / /chen po gzhan la bsten na 'grub/ /chu yi thigs pa nyam chung yang / /mtsho dang 'dres na skem mi nus/ /rang la blo gros mi ldan na/ /blo chen gzhan la legs par 'dri/ /lag pas dgra bo mi gsod na/ /mtshon cha len par mi byed dam/ /gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo yang / /thabs dang ldan na grogs su 'gyur/ /dug chen lus la gnod mod kyi/ /sbyor ba shes na sman du 'gyur/ /rigs pas rnyed pa'i zas nor blang / /88

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/mi 'os gzhan la rlom sems spang / /shing tog shing rtse las blang gi /de las thal na sa la lhung / /mkhas pas sgrim par mi byed pa/ /de yi bar la nyes pa 'byung / /blo dang ldan pas rab bsgrims na/ /nyes pa 'byung ba'i go skabs dka'/ /ji srid rang stobs ma rdzogs par/ /de yi bar du dgra rnams bkur/ /nus pa rdzogs nas gang rigs pa/ /bya zhes bstan bcos gzhan dag smra/ /dgra bo snyan par smra na yang / /blo dang ldan pa yid mi brtan/ /chu skyar byi la des pa yis/ /pha rol gsod la rtag tu brtson/ /89

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/yul gyi bdag po zhe sdang yang / / de la dga' bas bsten te bsdad/ /sa la rkang ba 'dred gyur na/ /sa nyid la ni brten pa bzhin/ /ha cang 'dod la brkam pa yis skye bo myur du brlag par 'gyur/ /mchil ba'i sha la chags pa yis /nya rnams de ma thag tu gsod/ /mchod 'os pa dang 'khor rnams kyang / /rtag tu sbyin pas bsdu bar bya/ /mchod gtor la ni lha rnams dang / /yi dwags bar du mgu bas bsrung / /chen po rnams kyis rtsed mo dang / /bde dang zas la chags pa spang / /'dod la zhen pa'i le lan gyis/ /90

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/'bod grogs lang ka bsad ces grags/ /byams rtsod gnyis ka chen po dang / /bya yi dman dang nam yang min/ /nyo tshong rin chen la bya yi/ /sbyar dug la ni de ltar min/ /dpya ba mang phyir rgyal bo'i mdzod/ /ha cang mi bsdu nyung ngus khengs/ /grog mkhar sbrang rtsi yar ngo yi /zla ba nyung ngu nyung ngus khengs/ /rje bos 'bangs la mi gnod par/ /rigs pa'i lam gyis dpya rnams bsdu/ /sā la'i shing las spos kyi bcud/ /gzags pa mang na skam par 'gyur/ /rje bo lhag par des pa dgos/ /91

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyu mtshan chung ngus khro mi rung / /sbrul la nor bu yod na yang / /sems shes su zhig drung du sdod/ /gang zhig nor 'dod skye bos kyang / /chos nyid gtso bor bsrung bar bya/ /chos las nyams pa'i nor tsam ni/ /'jig rten 'dir yang ga la rtag /ha cang byams thal gnyen la'ang min/ /shin tu gnod che dgra la'ang min/ /gnyen la re ba 'khon gzhi ste/ /gnod lan kun gyis bsgrub par sla/ /'jam pos 'jam po 'joms byed cing / /'jam pos rtsub po'ang 'joms par byed/ /'jam pos kun 'grub de yi phyir/ /'jam nyid rno zhes mkhas rnams smra/ /92

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/su la'ang bdag gi dgra yin pa/ /'ga' yang bdag la mi byams zhes/ /mi byams na yang de mi bsgrag /bsgrags na de nyid 'byed pa'i sel/ /ngo tsha khrel la mi lta zhing / /mchod dang brnyas pa'i khyad mi shes/ /zas dang nor la chags ldan pa/ /de 'dra'i gnas su bsdad mi bya/ /yul gzhan legs par ma brtags par/ /snga ma'i gnas ni dor mi bya/ /rkang ba ya gcig ma btsugs par/ /gnyis ka btegs na 'gyel ba'i rgyu/ /rang spyod 'bad pas sba bar bya/ /phal cher gsal bar bstan pas nyams/ /spre'u zlos gar mi byed na/ /93

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/mgul du thag pa ci ste 'dogs/ /nyes pa mngon sum madmeng na yang / /gnas ma yin la spru mi bya/ /ltas ngan mthong na smra ba po'i/ /thog tu 'byung zhes 'jig rten sgrogs/ /gzhan gyis brnyas par 'gyur ba yi/ /nor dang zas kyis ci zhig bya/ /khyi phag mi gtsang za ba la/ /mkhas pa su zhig yid smon byed/ /pha rol gnad du 'bebs pa'i tshig /dgra bo la yang smra mi bya/ / brag ca bzhin du rang nyid la/ /de ma thag tu le lan 'byung / /gal te dgra la gnod 'dod na/ /94

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rang nyid yon tan ldan par bya/ /de yis dgra yang sems sreg cing / /rang yang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyar/ /stomi bsrun 'gro la byams —sems bskyed/ /rtsub spyod kho nas gdul bar bya /rang gi lus la phan 'dod rnams/ /gtar dpyadartsokyis ni nad rnams 'don/ /gnod par byed pa chung ngu yang / /myur du bsal la 'dum par bya /yur ba chung ngu'i rjes zhugs nas/ /'od pa chen po ma mthong ngam / /mkhas pas bya ba ma yin pa'i/ /bya ba shes kyang mi bya'o/ /glang bos dgra sde bcom pa yis/ /rgyun du rgyal bos bcings la ltos/ /95

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rang phyogs sdang yang spang mi bya/ /dgra bo byams kyang 'khu mi bya/ /bya rog bya rog gis 'tshe yang / /nyin mo long ba bsten na phung / /bya ba che chung gang byed kyang / /mkhas pas rtag tu bsgrims te bya/ /seng ges ri bong glang chen gnyis/ /gsod pa'i tshe na sgrim klod med/ /yon tan ldan pa mi bkur ba'i/ /gnas der mkhas pa su zhig sdod/ /chu shel me rdor byed pa yi/ /yul der chu shel 'tshong ngam ci/ /mkhas pas gzhan la bshad pa'am/ /yang na zhi ba'i gnas su bsgrub/ /nor bu spyi gtsug rgyan byed dam/ /96

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/min na rgya mtsho'i gling na gnas/ /bdag pas mtho ba'i dam pa la/ /bsnyen na bdag la phan pa sgrub/ /lhun po'i ngos la gnas pa yi/ /bya rnams gser du snang bar 'gyur/ /chen po phrag dog ldan pa la/ /brten na chen po thob mi 'gyur/ /nyi ma'i 'od la nye ba yis/ /zla ba mar ngor gyur la ltos/ /mi gang mdza' ba mi brtan pa/ /de dang 'grogs par su zhig 'tham/ /nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon mdog mdzes kyang / /rgyan du re na blun po 'khrul/ /bdag nyid gang la mi dga' ba/ /97

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ gzhan la kun tu de mi bya/ / gzhan gyis cung zad gtses pa'i tshe/ /rang la bsam pa ci 'byung soms/ /gang zhig bdag nyid gang dga' ba/ /de nyid gzhan la sbyar byas na/ /gzhan gyis bdag la gang dga' ba/ /de yi tshul gyis mchod par 'gyur/ /dmu rgod rnams dang mdza' ba dang / /rtsod pa gnyis ka mkhas pas spang / /'gras pa dang ni 'dris pa'i tshul/ /gnyis ka steg la byar mi rung / /dam pa dag la bsten pa dang / /mkhas pa dag la 'dri ba dang / /gzhung bzang bo dang 'grogs pa ni/ /su la yod pa rgyun du bde/ /98

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/dus su ma bab pa yi gtam/ /gang smra de la kun gyis brnyas/ /mang bo smra ba'i gtam tshig las/ /smyon par rjes su mi dpog gam / /nyam chung rnams kyis rang nyid kyi/ /smra ba thams cad 'khrul bar bsam/ /de ltar go nas mi smra ba'i/ /mi la gzhan gyis bkur ba nye/ /yul dang dus la bab pa'i tshe/ /rab tu bsgrims te lan 'ga' smra/ /legs bshad yin yang mang gyur na/ /tshong zong lhag bzhin brin mi 'gyur/ /rang skyon mkhas pa rnams kyis kyang / /skyon du go ba shin tu dka'/ /ci mang bos bdag la de sgrogs na/ /

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/ skyon can yin par rjes su dpog /go yang skyon de mi 'dor na/ /mi de gdon gyis btab pa yin/ /da dung gnyen po mi 'jug na/ /mi yin snyam du ma sems shig /cung zad bsam pa yod rnams kyis/ /skyon de brnag la gdon par bya/ /de ltar gnyen po spyod pa yi/ /mi de gong nas gong du 'gro/ /blo dang ldan pa'am byams kyang rung / /bsgo ba nyan pa'am dpa' yang rung / /gzhan gyi bya ba mi shes kyang / /de dang de yi spyod pas skyong / /mi bsrun pa yi 'brel ba dang / /100

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/ring nas 'grogs kyang spangs na bde/ /rtag tu 'gul ba'i so bzang yang / /bton na bde zhes rgan po smra/ /rgyun du 'khang zhing 'khor ba yi/ /'brel ba cung zad byin la bskrad/ /sbrul gyis zin pa'i rma dag ni/ /gcod ma nus na srog dang 'bral/ /gal te chen po thob gyur na/ /phran tshegs gzhan la ser sna spang / /yul 'khor dbang du 'du ba na/ /dbyig la ser sna byed dam ci/ /mkhas pa longs spyod gsog 'dod na/ /cha shas sbyin pa srung ba che/ /khron pa'i chu ni 'phel 'dod na/ /'chu ba nyid ni gdams ngag yin/ /101

legs bshad bstanabacosaphyogasabasgrigs/ da gang zhig phun sum tshogs 'dod na/ /de yis 'du 'god mang du bya/ /'du 'dzi sdug bsngal rgyur mthong na/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i re ba thongs/ /bya ba gang zhig bsgrub na yang / /skyon dang yon tan gnyis gnyis soms/ /gnyis ka mnyam yang spang dgos na/ /nyes pa shas che smos ci dgos/ /mkhas pa drang bo gus pas bsten/ /mkhas pa g.yo can shes na gzab/ /rmongs pa drang bo byams pas bskyang / /rmongs pa g.yo can myur du spang / /nor dang g.yog 'khor med na yang / /mdza' bo blo ldan grogs yod na/ /dud 'gros kyang ni don 'grub na/ /102

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/mi yi 'gro bas smos ci dgos/ /gang zhig shes pa'i bya ba bsgo/ /mi nus pa la 'ga' mi sbyar/ /chu la shing rtase mi bgrod de/ / thang la gru yis ji ltar 'gro / /yun ring 'khon pa'i dgra bo dang —/ /mdza' ba byed kyang bsre mi bya/ /shin tu khol ba'i chu yis kyang / /me dang phrad na mi gsod dam/ /gzhung bzang ngo tsha khrel yod na/ /dgra bo la yang yid brtan rung / /gzhung bzang dgra la skyabs song bas/ /srog gi bar du bskyabs pa thos /rang la ngan sems med ces te/ /103

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/phal ba kun la yid mi brtan/ /ri dwags rgyun du sems bzang yang / /mche ba can rnams zas su bsgom/ /blun po log pa'i lam 'gro na/ /blun po nyid du go bas chog /mkhas pa log pa'i lam 'gro na/ /rgyu mtshan gang zhig dpyad dgos so/ /mkhas pas longs spyod lhag par spyad/ /mi ster na yang 'phrog pa med/ /longs spyod nyams pa'i sa phyogs spang / /mi 'phrog na yang brnya skyis 'joms/ /rang gis legs par shes na yang / /bya ba thams cad gros kyis bsgrub/ /mi gang gros la mi dga' ba/ /'gyod pa rin gyis nyo ba yin/ /104

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/nyam nga'i gros dag byed pa na/ /mdza' yang gsum du gros mi bya/ /ro langs sgrub pa'i grogs ngan na/ /thog mar sgrub po za bar 'gyur/ /len shes snyoms par gtong la mkhas/ /dul zhing kun gyi ngo bsrung ba/ /'jigs med byas pa chud mi gzan/ /mi des 'dod na sa kun thob/ /gal te dgra bo skyabs 'ong na/ /de la mchod nas snyan pa brjod/ /khu tas byi ba la brten nas/ /bde ba thob ces sngon rabs smra/ /grogs po ngan dang thos pa ngan/ /rtog pa ngan dang bya ba ngan/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis mi bya ste/ /105

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/byed na blun po gud na med/ / legs par brtags nas byed pa la/ /bya ba nyamasane pa ga la srid/ / mig ldan brtags nas 'gro ba na/ /g.yang sar gom pa 'dor ram ci/ /rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phel 'gyar ba'i /stoyon tan slob na mkhas pa'i rtags/ /rig pa 'ga' zhig mda' mkhan ltar/ /shes pa nyid na cho 'brang 'jig / rang nyid cis kyang mtho 'dod na/ /gzhan la phan pa 'ba' zhig gyis/ /byad la byi dor byed pa rnams/ /sngon du me long mi 'phyi 'am/ /pha rol ci nas gzhom 'dod na/ /106

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rang gi yon tan 'bad pas sgrub/ /dgra bo gsod par 'dod pa rnams/ /mtshon cha 'bad nas sgrub la ltos/ /g.yo can tshig la dron 'jug pas/ /drang bos de la brtag dpyad dgos/ /bslus rjes kho bo drang ngo zhes/ /rang la bstod pas ci zhig phan/ /g.yo can sogs la g.yo sogs dang / /drang bo sogs la drang bo ste/ /mi brtan pa la brtan dgos zhes/ /bya ba sngon gyi yig tshangasayin/ /mkhas pas rtag tu dgra la yang / /gnyen des rkyen du byas na legs/ /de yis 'dum la mi phan yang / /nges par gnod sems 'jil ba'i sman/ /107

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/tshig ngan brjod pas 'jig rten du/ /'dod pa 'grub pa mi srid kyis/ /yid la rang 'dod bsgrub na yang / /ngag gis kun dang mthun par gyis/ /rang dang gzhan gyi don grub na/ /'jam rtsub ji ltar byas kyang rung / /thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa la/ /g.yo sgyu thub pas ma gsungs so/ /tha mar shin tu phan pa'i gros/ /'phral la sdug kyang mkhas pas bsten/ /rgas shing gdungs na yon tan rnams/ /bu gcig pa la mkhas rnams slob/ /longs spyod ha cang 'phel drags na/ /de la rgud pa shin tu nye/ /chu yis shin tu gang ba yi/ /108

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rdzing bu stong ngam yang na 'dral/ /skye bo 'ga' la phan pa'i las/ /la las de la 'jug mi rung / /sgog skya rlung la phan mod kyi/ /mkhris pa'i nad la dug tu 'gyur/ /nyam chung rtag tu bskyang dgos dang / /'grogs na chen po nyams dogs yod/ /zhun mar snod du bzhag gyur na/ /snod la byi bas mi rmug gam/ /ngan pa rnams la brten byas na/ /ngan pa'i shan gyis rang la gnod/ /yur ba'i chu la brten pa yi/ /nya rnams zhing la 'grems la ltos/ /gzhung ngan bdag la brten 'cha' na/ /109

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de la cung zad byin te bskrad/ /khyim du ltas ngan byung gyur na/ /nor las phris te bzlog pa dgos/ /dam pa gzhan du 'gro na yang / /bsnyen bkur byas te nye bar bzhag /nor bu rin chen rtag mchod na/ /bkra shis dpal dang bsam pa 'grub/ /dman pa'i skye bo bstod drags na/ /phyi nas de nyid khyad du gsod/ /mkha' la mi gtsang gtor gyur na/ /'thor ba po yi spyi bor 'bab/ /skye bo blo ldan mgo smad na/ /smod byed nyid la nyes pa 'phog /mar me thur du kha bstan na/ /ston pa po yi lag pa sreg /110

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/gang dang gang gi gnas yin par/ /de dang de yi gnas su bzhag /gtsug rgyan rkang bar mi gdags te / / rkang ba'i rkang rgyan spyi gtsug min/ / bya ba chen po sgrub pa'i tshe/ /'bad pa yis ni grogs bzang bsten/ /nags tshal chen po mes bsreg na/ /rlung zhig ci nas grogs su dgos/ /byams pas khyab pa'i tshig smra ba/ /bsgrub sla gzhan dga' sdud pa'i mchog /nor gyis mgu bar su yis nus/ /lus srog btang yang phyed mi tshim/ /phongs kyang gdung bar mi bya ste/ /'byor yang dga' bas dregs mi bya/ /las kyi 'phen pa rgyang ring bas /111

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/skyid sdug sna tshogs da gdod 'byung / /rab tuzud pa dgu ba/ tshos brtag pa/'gro mgon sangs rgyas bzhugs bzhin du/ /ston pa gzhan la gus byed pa/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu 'gram du/ /ba tshwa'i khron pa brko ba yin/ /dngos po gang dang gang la yang / /goms na dka' ba ci yang med/ /bzo yi rig byed sbyangs pa ltar/ /dam chos dka' ba med par 'grub/ /gang zhig nyung ngus chog shes pa/ /de yi longs spyod zad mi shes/ /chog shes med par tshol ba la/ /112

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/sdug bsngal char bzhin rgyun du 'bab/ /nam dgos tshe na len pa yi/ /nor ni sbyin par thub pas gsungs/ /bsags pa'i nor ni sbrang rtsi ltar/ /nam zhig gzhan gyis spyod par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'di na bun btang bas/ /dngos po thob pa'i nges pa med/ /slong la byin na 'bad med par/ /chung yang brgya 'gyur thob pa yin/ /'jungs la phyug po mi srid cing / /gtong la dbul bo mi srid pas/ /'jungs pa nor dad chung ba dang / /gtong ba nor la rngam pa 'dra/ /byin na dbul 'gyur dogs pa yis/ /113

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'jungs pas sbyin pa mi gtong la/ /ser snas nges par phongs 'gyur bas/ /blo ldan cung zad rnyed —pa gtong / /bzhag na nor skyed mi 'phel bas /tshong bas zong rnams 'grems pa ltar/ /bsags na dbang phyug mi thob pas/ /mkhas pas tshong bzhin phyogs bcur ster/ /bye ba stong phrag gter yod kyang / /su zhig la yang gtong mi byed/ /de dag 'jig rten 'di dbul zhes/ /thos mang rnams kyis de skad bshad/ /rigs rgyud rgud kyis dogs pas na/ /blo chung cung zad rnyed pa gsog /mkhas pa rigs rgyud mtho thob phyir/ /gsug bzhin gzhan la sbyin pa gtong / /114

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/rigs rgyud phyug por bya snyam nas/ /rang nyid btsongs nas bu la ster/ /bu ngan pha la rgol bzhin du/ /nor rnams brlags nas khyi bzhin 'khyam/ /ji ltar pha ma bur byams kyang / /de ltar bu tshas pha ma min/ /pha mas bu tsha bskyangs bskyangs nas/ /pha ma rgas na bu tshas brnyas / /nor gsog 'jungs pa'i phyug po dang / /dgos sar gtong ba'i phyug po gnyis/ /rang dang rigs rgyud gnyis ka la/ /'jig rten gzhan gyis bye brag 'byed/ /srid pa'i khol por gyur pa rnams/ /srog dang bsdos nas nor phyir 'brang / /chog shes can gyis nor rnyed kyang / /115

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/des pa bzhin du gzhan la ster/ /bdog pa btang bas sbyin pa rdzogs/ /de la khro na bzod pa 'phel /tshim na rjes su yi rang bsgom/ /des na sbyin pa chos kyi mchog /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i snod gyur pa'i/ /lus 'di dgra dang 'dra mod kyi/ /blo dang ldan pas 'khol shes na/ /'di la bsod nams rten du rung / /skad cig 'jig pa'i tshe na yang / /dge ba'i bag chags ring du 'khyer/ /rlung gis bsgos pa'i tsan dan dri/ /ring du 'thul yang dga' ba bskyed/ /yun ring bde ba spyad spyad nas/ /116

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/'bral ba'i sdug bsngal lhag par che/ /rang dbang med par 'chi dgos pa/ /'di la rtag 'dzin de dag brlag /gnyen bshes kun gyis mtha' bskor te/ /gcom bskyungs mig rtsa shin tu zhan/ /gang phyogs 'gro ba'i gtol med pa/ /de tshe dge ba gzhan rnams phung / /ngan song gsum po'i nad rnams ni/ /ma byung ba nas gso bar bya/ /gnam lcags mgo la bab pa ltar/ /thog tu babs na ci byar yod/ /mdza' bshes kun dang bral ba dang / /nges par 'chi ba shes bzhin du/ /da dung bde bar gnyid phebs pa/ /bdag nyid snying la ci zhig zhugs/ /117

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gang gis brtson par mi nus kyang / /ci nas ngan 'gror mi ltung bya/ /dpa' bos dgra sde ma sod na'ang / /rang phyogs gsod par byed dam ci/ /'phral du cung zad sdug na yang / /rgyun du bde ba mkhas pas bsten/ /gtar bsreg dag gis nad 'don pa/ /sman pa mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs yin/ /gal te gzhan dag phun tshogs pas/ /bdag gi yid la mi bzod na/ /de yis rang 'byor 'joms pa'i phyir/ /rang la phrag dog byed par zad/ /gnod par bya phyir dgra 'joms na/ /khyod kyis khro ba kho na choms/ /khro bas 'khor ba thog med nas/ /118

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/bdag la gnod pa mtha' las 'das/ /gal te dgra kun brlag 'dod na/ /bsad pas de kun ga la 'dzad/ /rang gi khro ba gcig bcom pas/ /dgra kun cig car bsad pa yin/ /mthu chen gzu lums spyod pa la/ /khros na rang la lhag par gnod/ /dam pa nye bar zhi ba la/ /khro bar bya rgyu ga la yod/ /sdong bu gcig las skyes pa yi/ /rtswa rnams rlung gis phyogs bcur 'thor/ /de bzhin lhan cig skyes pa yi/ /skye bo las kyis so sor 'bral/ /sngon chad ma mthong 'brel bar 'thams/ /119

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/de nas slar yang gzhan 'gro ba'i/ /mi de bdag dang cir 'brel na/ /shi nas mya ngan chen po byed/ /rang don 'bad pas bsgrub 'dod na/ /de yis dang por gzhan don sgrubs/ /rang don kho na gtsor byed pa/ /de yis rang don 'grub mi srid/ /mi gang gzhan don gtsor byed na/ /g.yo can rang don sgrub pa 'dra/ /rang don 'ba' zhig gtsor byed pa/ /gzhan mgo 'don phyir drang ba 'dra/ /blo ldan tshe 'di bsgrub na yang / /chos kyis bsgrub na bde bar 'grub/ /dam pa rnams dang chom rkun gyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i khyad par ltos/ /120

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba//mi rnams tshe thung de yi phyed/ /mtshan mo gnyid log shi dang 'dra/ /na rga'i sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis/ /phyed po'ang bde bar spyad du med/ /skye bo kun gyi drung sdod pa'i/ /'chi bdag gal te mngon sum mthong /bya ba gzhan dag lta ci smos/ /za bar dran pa'i nus pa med/ /khyod kyis bya ba zin nam zhes/ /'chi bdag sdod par mi 'gyur gyis/ /nges par bya dgos yod na ni/ /de ring nyid du brtun la gyis/ /bdag gi bya ba ma zin pas/ /re zhig de ring khyod bzhugs zhes/ /mchi mas brnangs te gsol btab kyang / /121

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/'chi bdag bcos su ga la rung / /'du 'dzi spangs pa bde ba ste/ /min na bzang bo rnams dang 'grogs/ /dug sprul gso ba ga la legs/ /gso na bzlas brjod brtson par bya/ /sems ni rnam par g.yengs pa la/ /dam chos bsgrub pa'i go skabs med/ /nye bar zhi bar gnas pa la/ /sems ni las rung shin tu nye/ / dmigs pa kun la rab mkhas shing / /ting nge 'dzin gyis sems dul ba/ /'phags pa'i chos la rab sbyangs na/ /yon tan kun gyi zhing sa yin/ /blun po slob pa ngo tshar 'dzin/ /122

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/mkhas rnams ma bslabs ngo tshar 'dzin/ /des na mkhas rnams rgas gyur kyang / /phyi ma'i don du rig pa slob/ /shes rab med pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis/ /blun po yon tan mi slob lo/ /brtags na shes rab med nyid kyis/ /blun pos 'bad pa lhag par dgos/ /skye ba snga mar ma bslabs pas/ /tshe 'dir blun por mthong nas ni/ /phyi mar blun por skye dogs pas/ /tshe 'dir dka' yang 'bad de mnyan/ /bsgom na thos pa mi dgos zhes/ /blun po blo rgya chung ngu smra/ /thos pa med par bsgom pa tsam/ /'bad kyang dud 'gro'i sgrub thabs yin/ /123

da legasabashad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa 'di/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i khyad chos yin/ /ma bslabs pa la kun mkhyen du/ /'gro na rgyu 'bras ga la bden/ /thos pa med pa'i bsgom pa de/ /re zhig grub kyang myur du 'jig /gser dngul legs par bzhu na yang / /me dang bral na sra bar 'gyur/ /shes rab kyis ni gting brtags nas/ /nyes rgyu spong ba sgom pa yin/ /lus kyi dri ma bkrus pa ltar/ /bsgoms kyang ring zhig lon nas ldog /rgyu 'bras phul byung ma tshogs par/ /bdag med rtogs kyang 'tshang mi rgya/ /thabs mchog dag gis ma bsgrubs pa'i/ /124

da wa da wa saskyalegasabashad kyi rtsa ba/bden par mthong yang dgra bcom min/ /des na chos rnams legs rtogs te/ /ting nge 'dzin la sems bzhag na/ /nyes pa bag chags dang bcas pa/ /gang gis spangs pa rdzogs 'tshang rgya/ /gang la blo gros mi ldan na/ /bstan bcos legs kyang su zhig len/ /nor bus spras pa'i gser gyi rgyan/ /mdzes kyang ba lang ga la lta/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis legs bshad kun/ /shin tu bden par go bzhin du/ /de don nyams su mi len na/ /bstan bcos shes kyang ci zhig bya/ /rang la dgos pa'i bstan bcos rnams/ /125

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/nyi ma re rer tshig re zungs/ /grog mkhar dang ni sbrang rtsi ltar/ /ring bor mi thogs mkhas par 'gyur/ /legs par spyod la 'jug 'dod na/ /ci nas de yi kha mnyan te/ /rnam pa kun tu sran btsugs nas/ /srog la babs kyang lugs bzhin bskyang / /de la 'bad pas gzhung lugs nas/ /'byung bzhin gnyen pos bsgrub nus na/ /mkhas rnams rdzun pa mi gsung gi /'di yi phan yon phyi nas ltos/ /sngon yang 'di bzhin spyad rnams 'phel/ /da lta na yang de ltar mthong / /gtan tshigs bzang bo 'di yis ni/ /ma 'ongs rnams kyang phun tshogs 'thob/ /126

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/blo ldan rang gis shes na yang / /mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs gus pas blta/ /rin chen shin tu bzang bo yang /ma btsongs bar du rin thang chung / /nags tshal shin tu mang mod kyang / /tsan dan sa mchog skye ba nyung / /de bzhin mkhas pa mang na yang / /legs bshad 'byung ba shin tu dka'/ /rta mchog 'gro ba'i tshe na shes/ /gser dngul bzhu na shes par 'gyur/ /glang chen g.yul ngor shes 'gyur te/ /mkhas pa legs bshad rtsom na shes/ /gang zhig 'jig rten thams cad kyis/ /rang la tshad mar byed 'dod na/ /de yis gzhung 'di legs brtags te/ /127

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/gnyen po bskyed la 'bad de bsgrub/ /'jig rten bya ba legs shes pa/ /de yis dam pa'i chos lugs 'grub/ /des na chos lugs spyod pa de/ /byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar yin/ / ྾ ྾ ྾ 'tsho byed zas su sgro btags nas/ /sman gyis nad chen gso ba ltar/ /'jig rten lugs kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /bdag gis dam pa'i chos 'di bstan/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i gling las legs 'khrungs nas/ /blo gros klu yi dbang bos yongs bzung ba/ /dpal ldan legs par bshad pa rin chen gter/ /blo gsal blo yi bang mdzod dgang ba dang / /mkhas pa rnams kyi 'dod dgu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /128

sa skya legs bshad kyi rtsa ba/shākya'i dge slong kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang bos dge ba'i yid kyis legs brtags nas/ /phyogs rnams gsal bar bya phyir 'di phye'o/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba dri ma med/ /bsil zer byed po'i 'od ltar rab gsal bas/ /skye bo snying gi mun pa phyir bsal te/ /blo gsal blo yi ku mud rgyas gyur cig /shes bya kun la rab sbyangs pas/ /thams cad mkhyen pa thob bya'i phyir/ /des na bdag gi bstan bcos 'di/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob phyir byas/ /legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos/ yul byang phyogs kyi rgyud kha ba can gyi ljongs/ byang chub kyi snying bo rdo rje'i gdan las dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa'i gnas/ gtsang la stod grom pa dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang du gnas pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi thugs kyi 'od zer gyis 129

legs bshad bstan bcos phyogs bsgrigs/blo'i padmo'i ze'u 'bru cung zad kha phye bas/ sgra dang / tshad ma dang / snyan ngag dang / sdeb sbyor dang / tshig gi rgyan dang / bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi don yongs su grags pa phal mo che thos shing rtogs nas khong du chud cing 'dris par byas pas/ lung dang rigs pa dang man ngag gi gnad phyin ci ma log par blo gros kyi snang ba thob pa/ 'chad pa dang / rtsom pa dang / rtsod pa la sogs pa'i tshul la spobs pa dge ba can/ shākya'i dge slong rigs par smra ba kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo zhes bya bas/ dpal sa skya'i dgon par legs par sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so/ /maṅga lo/ /130
